articleTitle: Research on the Aerospace Mechatronic Servo System’s Digital Production Line Construction
publicationTitle: 2021 4th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Based on the application in the aeronautics and astronautics area of the digital factory technology, the manufacturing modes feature and the technical bottleneck of the mechatronic servomechanism assembly and testing have been analyzed, the construction goals and overall plan of the digital production line have been brought up, and researches on the batch-production and technology have been implemented. By reconfiguring the assembly and testing technology process, optimizing the manufacturing arrangement and building the digital production equipment and software management control platform, a digital production line for multi-variety and small-batches EMAs has been constructed to improve the production capacity and management ability.

articleTitle: Active Vibration Control of Thin Plate Milling Using Piezoelectric Actuator
publicationTitle: 2021 4th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Milling vibration is one of the critical factors affecting the surface quality of thin plate milling. Active control strategies have attracted more and more attention because of the high adaptive capacity. However, during control, it is difficult to obtain the vibration signal of the cutting position of the workpiece. In this paper, a modified Filtered-x Least Mean Square (MFxLMS) algorithm is constructed considering the deviation between sensor position and the cutting position of the workpiece. The convergence conditions of the algorithm are studied, as well as the factors affecting the convergence speed. Based on piezoelectric actuators and acceleration sensors, some simulation and experimental validations are carried out to verify the proposed method. The results indicate that the method is effective for vibration suppression during milling process, and the surface quality of the thin plate can be obviously improved.

articleTitle: Welding quality analysis and prediction based on deep learning
publicationTitle: 2021 4th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: With the development of intelligent manufacturing, a certain automobile production line has accumulated a large number of automatic collection of welding process data. But the traditional automobile spot welding process lacks of welding data analysis. Now through artificial intelligence means to analyze data, so as to achieve the prevention of quality defects. Considering the difficulty of welding quality prediction due to the high nonlinearity of welding process and the complex interaction of various factors, a welding quality analysis and prediction model based on deep learning was proposed. Based on the analysis of weld spatter factors, a welding quality prediction model was established by Residual Neural Network (ResNet), taking the characteristic point at the end of metal bonding process, the maximum voltage and the wear state of electrode cap as input parameters. The results show that the accuracy of the model is 88.9%, which provides a basis for automatic control of welding quality.

articleTitle: Mobile robot path planning based on improved genetic algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 4th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: In view of the disadvantage that the traditional genetic algorithm cannot be planned when it is applied to robot path planning in a special environment, the population initialization method is improved first, and the path planned by the two-way RRT algorithm replaces a part of the initialization population to form an elite population. Then this paper improve the fitness function, add path smoothing coefficients and obstacle coefficients to ensure path quality, and at the same time add elite strategies to speed up the convergence speed; finally, the traditional genetic algorithm, two-way RRT algorithm, and the algorithm of this paper is carried out in the same map environment. The results show that the elite population genetic algorithm proposed in this paper overcomes the shortcomings of traditional genetic algorithms that are difficult to plan paths in special environments, has higher adaptability to the environment, and improves the success rate of path planning.

articleTitle: Multi AGV simulation system of intelligent workshop based on Digital Twin
publicationTitle: 2021 4th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: In view of the gradual transformation of workshop production mode to multi variety and variable batch production mode, the requirements for workshop logistics system are becoming higher and higher. This paper presents the construction of multi AGV simulation operation system in intelligent workshop based on digital twin, and introduces three key technologies to realize multi AGV simulation operation under the framework of digital twin technology. It includes digital twin modeling and simulation control technology of intelligent workshop, multi AGV path planning technology based on task priority strategy and twin state driven multi AGV simulation operation technology. Through the implementation and application of the system in an aerospace production general assembly workshop, not only the workshop logistics path planning scheme is optimized, but also the specific verification of the workshop multi AGV logistics simulation scheme is realized. At the same time, the consumption of workshop resources is reduced, which provides technical reference for workshop managers.

articleTitle: Research on Prediction of Equipment Remaining Life : Based on Simulated Annealing Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 4th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: With the advancement of technology and the development of socialized mass production, there are many complex engineering equipment systems which are reliable, long life, long-term online use or multi-operation state alternation. Once a small local failure occurs, it may lead to catastrophic consequences. Therefore, it is a significant engineering problem to predict the remaining useful life(RUL) of equipments. For the residual life prediction of equipments, the single-dimensional Boolean two-parameter distribution model and the dual Weibull distribution model are applied to describe the life characteristics of the equipment, and the simulated annealing algorithm is used to estimate the unknown parameters of the Weibull distribution of equipment life. The experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness and accuracy of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Road sign detection and recognition system based on multi-layers convolutional neural network model trained with German Traffic Sign Recognition Benchmark
publicationTitle: 2021 4th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Traffic sign detection and recognition play a vital role in the development of self-driving systems. It helps to increase the safety of drivers during the driving process. However, its accuracy will be sometimes affected by certain environmental factors and the accuracy needs to be improved. This paper proposes a detection and recognition system with a 8 layers convolutional neural network that acquires different kinds of features by training with different kinds of traffic signs. The training made an outstanding contribution to our detection and recognition system, allowing our system to be more comprehensive and precise compared with most current systems, which solved the problems of limited accuracy and performance under the effects of environmental factors.

articleTitle: Recognition of Material Surfaces with Smart Gloves Based on Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 4th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Nowadays, wearable devices have been extensively studied in the fields of human-robot interaction and motion detection. As a wearable device, smart glove plays a significant role in intellisense. In this paper, a prototype of smart gloves is made by attaching an ultra-thin, sensitive and stretchable ZNS-01 sensor to the surface of ordinary gloves and a data acquisition system is built to collect the data of human hands to touch the surface of the table, wood, plastic, steel, and paper. Time domain characteristics and frequency domain characteristics are extracted as input to train different machine learning models. The prediction results of different machine learning algorithms are compared and the XGBoost shows strong generalization ability and the prediction effect is better. This smart glove can provide a reliable reference for material recognition.

articleTitle: Influence of heat source location on heat dissipation performance of an underwater scientific instrument interface module
publicationTitle: 2021 4th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: A single-point electromechanical (EM) cable subsurface mooring (EMC-SSM) is an observation platform used in measuring a variety of ocean parameters throughout the water column in real time. The scientific instrument interface module (SIIM) is a key component of the EMC-SSM, which provides electricity to the scientific instruments mounted on the EMCSSM. When a large number of instruments are installed on the EMC-SSM and working at the same time, the output power of the SIIM can be large, which leads to an increase in SIIM internal temperature and a decrease in reliability of the SIIM. In this paper, basic theoretical model on the internal space of the SIIM is proposed and Fluent software is used to make a study of the influences of heat source locations to temperature rises. The influence of vertical and horizontal coordinates on temperature rise and their curves in a helium-filled cylindrical space are obtained. It is found that the influence of vertical coordinate is greater than that of horizontal coordinate, but the influence of horizontal coordinate is more obvious when the heat source is close to the boundary. The heat source should be installed as close to the cavity wall as possible, and the narrow and appropriate length channel near the heat source is conducive to improving the heat dissipation performance. The evaluation method of optimum installation coordinates and specific optimum location are also given.

articleTitle: Automatic winding forming technology for manufacturing Glass Fiber Reinforced Plastic pipes
publicationTitle: 2021 4th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: With the rapid development of winding forming, more and more winding forming methods gradually introduced in the industry, medical, military, and other fields have more and more applications. In the industrial area of composite materials, winding forming technology has a high fit with the preparation of composite pipe fitting, which can positively reduce costs and improve production efficiency. This paper will study the forming method and theory of weaving fabric winding forming. Glass fiber cloth was used as material, and automatic equipment was used for winding. In the winding experiment, 0,0.5, and 1 were used as experimental variables, and the mechanical properties of the pipe fittings were tested by compression test. The influence of damping force on the mechanical properties of automatic winding is studied. The results show that the experimental pipe with damping coefficient of 2 has better mechanical properties. It is inferred that when the damping coefficient increases in a certain range, the pipe quality will be improved accordingly. At the same time, the rationality of the conclusion is verified by simulation.

articleTitle: Research on SCR Precise Ammonia Injection Control Based on BP Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2021 4th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Nowadays, selective catalytic reduction (SCR) is usually used in denitration optimization strategy of thermal power units. It can remove nitrogen oxides from flue gas. This denitration optimization system is influenced by chemical reaction and flue arrangement, and it has the characteristics of great inertia and great delay. Nitrogen oxides are usually measured by CEMS analysis instruments. They produce pure delay in flue gas extraction and analysis. Therefore, it is difficult to have good control effect on denitration system only by using traditional PID controller feedback regulation. Based on operation parameters of denitration system, this paper uses BP neural network algorithm to predict the export nitrogen oxide concentration. It is used to calculate ammonia quantity and realize precise control of ammonia injection.

articleTitle: Research on thermal error measuring point optimization and modeling of machine tool spindle
publicationTitle: 2021 4th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: In the CNC machining process, a main factor affecting the machining accuracy is thermal error. The optimization of spindle thermal error temperature measurement point is of great significance to establish the thermal error model of the machine tool spindle and improve the accuracy of the model. The temperature field of a vertical machining center and the thermal deformation of the machine tool spindle is obtained through experiments. According to the measured data, the temperature measurement points are grouped and optimized based on the method of fuzzy clustering and grey theory. The thermal error compensation model is established by using multiple linear regression. The verification shows that this method can effectively reduce the number of temperature measurement points. The thermal error compensation model with high precision is established, and the compensation rate is 91.3%, which is of great practical significance to improve the accuracy of the machine tool.

articleTitle: Intelligent Design Technology of Aircraft Structural Parts Based on Model and Knowledge
publicationTitle: 2021 4th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: In view of the complex assembly models of aircraft and ships, such as complex parts, many assembly parts, high design repetition rate and long design time in the process of designing each part, a human-machine intelligent design technology system for aircraft structural parts was proposed based on model and knowledge. The method was based on CATIA software platform. The intelligent variant design technology based on case-based reasoning (CBR) is implemented, which can quickly extract feature information and realize intelligent design. In order to improve the design efficiency of typical aircraft parts, a variant design module integrated with CATIA system is developed by using object-oriented programming language. Taking sheet metal parts of typical aircraft parts as an example, the variant design method is verified, and it is shown that the hybrid intelligent design system of aircraft parts can be realized by using CATIA secondary development technology and CAA programming tool.

articleTitle: Trotting gait control of quadruped robot based on Trajectory Planning
publicationTitle: 2021 4th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: In order to improve the motion stability and environmental adaptability of quadruped robot in trotting gait, a motion control method based on swing leg gait planning is proposed in this paper. The kinematics model of quadruped robot is established, the forward and inverse solutions are obtained, and the trajectory curve of swinging leg of quadruped robot in trotting gait is planned. The simulation model is established in ADAMS to verify that the trotting gait control method based on the foot trajectory planning of the swing leg is effective and feasible.

articleTitle: Study on Kinematics and Dynamics of Intelligent Connector of Safety Cable to Tower Imitating Crocodile Mouth Action
publicationTitle: 2021 4th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: In this study, the safety cable and connector are conveyed to the end of the tower and reliably connected with the receiver connector at the specified position of the tower by bionic technology through the foot handles and carrier of the robot designed. By action imitation of alligator clip in prey:target recognition, approach, target revisions, snap and close lock, and usage of mechanisms coalescence, machine vision, redundancy technology, sensing, a kind of double insurance type safe rigging and fixed position of connection device was designed with reliability of connection, convenient disassembly, and safety and smoothness in service. On this basis, the kinematics and dynamics characteristics at reference points of the telescopic arm and the flexible palm finger of the connector were studied to ensure the reliability and applicability of the connector, providing the basic life safety for the operator’s climbing and operation in maintenance of the high-voltage transmission line.

Author Keywords: action imitation of the crocodile mouth

articleTitle: Basic Models and Applications of Resistor-Capacitor Circuits and Simulations Using Falstad
publicationTitle: 2021 4th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: This paper discusses a common alignment of two passive components, capacitors and resistors, in circuits. In DC(Direct Current) circuits, the alignment of resistors and capacitors provides a time constant for both the charging and discharging process. Some basic applications are illustrated in the paper as Sioe et al. (2005) suggest incorporating resistors and capacitors to buffer the overheat in batteries. The paper then discusses the RC circuits under alternating current serving as a voltage divider due to the impeding effect to the current by the capacitors with calculation and simulations using Falstad (an online circuit simulator). Yasith et al. (2010) establishes a basic RC voltage divider and filter with tunable ionic liquid. First order low pass Butterworth filter is then discussed with calculations and simulations. This paper manages to establish some fundamental but significant directions in which RC circuits with more complex structure could be developed and utilized.

Author Keywords: first order low pass Butterworth filter

articleTitle: Research on Decoupling Motion Path Planning of Two Manipulators of Live Working Robot Based on Hybrid RRT Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 4th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Double manipulator path planning is the basis for overhead line live working robot to complete the task. The previous dual manipulator motion path planning method has some problems, such as low success rate, low convergence speed, unstable guidance, and easy to lead to path discontinuity in complex environment. Therefore, this paper proposes a decoupling motion planning method for two manipulators of live working robot based on hybrid RRT (Rapidly-Exploring Random Trees) algorithm. The hybrid RRT algorithm combines target offset RRT algorithm, bidirectional RRT algorithm and dynamic expansion RRT algorithm. MATLAB robot toolbox is used to simulate the motion path planning of 6-DOF double manipulator of overhead line live working robot. The results show that the method proposed in this paper can realize the loose coupling and efficient collision free motion planning of double manipulator of live working robot.

articleTitle: Construction of intelligent control platform for forging production line based on cyber-physical system
publicationTitle: 2021 4th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: This paper designs and studies the general structure of the forging production line based on CPS in view of the processing characteristics of multiple varieties and small batches of forging production. In the research process, the author built the CPS perception layer, network layer and control layer to improve the intelligent level of the production line of large-scale key bearing components, standard parts and structural parts of the aircraft. The author constructed a physical model of the host equipment for forging production in the CPS system, obtained production-related data of physical physical equipment through sensors, controllers, and collectors, and transmitted the data to the platform through multi-dimensional hybrid sensing and synchronous transmission technology. In the research process, the author uses artificial intelligence data processing technology to normalize and merge multi-source heterogeneous data and make decisions, and finally realize the feedback response to the decision through the end mechanical hardware such as controllers and actuators.

articleTitle: The design of longitudinal autonomous landing control for a fixed wing Unmanned Aerial vehicle
publicationTitle: 2021 4th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: UAVs are frequently used in civil and military applications because of their tiny size, lightweight, and high mobility. In the field of aerospace, uncrewed aerial vehicles (UAVs) have become a central development direction. The takeoff and landing technology is a challenging issue in UAV control technology throughout the entire flight phase. The design and simulation of a UAV’s longitudinal landing control system are finished in this study by using PID theory and MATLAB Simulink, respectively.

articleTitle: Research on soil thermal conductivity prediction algorithm based on improved BP neural network
publicationTitle: 2021 4th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: The measurement of soil thermal conductivity plays a key role in the soil heat source pump air conditioning system in the design area. In order to solve the problem that the measurement period of traditional soil thermal conductivity measurement is too long, a prediction model of soil thermal conductivity based on improved BP neural network learning algorithm is proposed. By collecting the average temperature in the U-pipe after 50 hours in different parts of the country, TRAINSCG (quantized conjugate gradient method), TRAINGD (gradient descent training function) and TRAINRP (elastic gradient descent method) were used to optimize and improve the prediction model to obtain the final prediction model of soil thermal conductivity, and the accuracy of the three improved algorithms was calculated by testing samples. The results show that the BP neural prediction model using TRAINSCG learning algorithm has the best prediction effect on soil thermal conductivity, the BP neural prediction model using TRAINSCG learning algorithm has a better prediction effect on soil thermal conductivity, and the BP neural network prediction model using TRAINGD learning algorithm has a poor prediction effect on soil thermal conductivity.

Author Keywords: BP neural network Soil thermal conductivity Prediction model Improved- learning algorithm

articleTitle: Application of Grey Correlation Method in Electronic Information Equipment Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2021 4th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: The experiment and evaluation of the performance of electronic information equipment require a reasonable quantitative evaluation method. In this paper, the theory of the gray correlation method is described and applied to the performance evaluation of electronic information equipment. This paper screens seven performance indicators of electronic information equipment, quantify the subjective assessments on the indicators by the AHP method, and assigns weights to the indicators. The gray correlation method is adopted to calculate and evaluate four sets of electronic information equipment performance data and derive the performance evaluation results of the equipment, proving the feasibility of the method in the field of electronic information equipment performance experiments and evaluations.

articleTitle: Cardioid crank Mechanism and its Application
publicationTitle: 2021 4th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: The cardioid crank mechanism is a planetary mechanism composed of a tie rod, a planetary wheel and a fixed central wheel which is the same as the planetary wheel. Some special motion mechanisms can be obtained by using the cardioid crank mechanism as the driving mechanism instead of the general crank mechanism, such as approximate uniform motion mechanism, approximate dwell mechanism, double working stroke mechanism and so on. In this paper, the characteristics of cardioid crank mechanism are analyzed, the influence of mechanism parameters on motion is discussed, and the basic method of constructing special motion mechanism is given.

articleTitle: The modal analysis of centrifugal fan vibration shaft based on ANSYS
publicationTitle: 2021 4th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: In order to determine the vibration characteristics of the vibrating shaft and avoid the damage to the equipment caused by the vibration shaft in the coal screener from being damaged by resonance, the mining Use ANSYS software to model the vibration axis and perform modal calculations. In the finite element analysis, the bearing is simply treated as a rigid constraint mode, and the first 10 order natural frequencies and modes can be obtained. The results of natural frequency and vibration calculation provide a reference for vibration shaft to choose the working frequency to avoid resonance. The normal operation of the moving shaft and the coal screener provides a design basis. Keywords: inverter; lead-acid battery; hydraulic pump station; emergency rescue; explosion-proof; control console

articleTitle: The State Monitoring System of numerical control machine tools spindle Based on LabVIEW
publicationTitle: 2021 4th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Aiming at the current problems of low efficiency,low effective information and high complexity of monitoring spindle parameters of numerical control machine tools,This article has designed a numerical control machine tools spindle monitoring system based on LabVIEW.Numerical control machine tools spindle monitoring system uses the NI PCI-6220 acquisition card to collect the temperature,tension and pressure force of spindle, displacement and other signals for acquisition, and then analyzes and processes the signal, displays and saves the signal data. After testing,The spindle monitoring system of the numerical control machine tools realizes the related functions of the design.The system is simple operate,intuitive,has good human-computer interaction and high degree of automation,greatly facilitates the monitoring of the spindle status.

articleTitle: Design of Underground Tunnel Monitoring System Based on CAN BUS Local Area Network
publicationTitle: 2021 4th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of low reliability of communication transmission in underground pipe corridors and complicated communication protocols for electrical equipment, this paper takes the reliable transmission and safety monitoring of data information of measurement and control nodes as the core, and proposes an underground tunnel monitoring system based on CAN bus local area network. The article introduces the overall design architecture and composition of the system, and details the main software and hardware design of the system and the Ethernet data frame format. In order to improve the reliability of the system network and the effectiveness of the measurement and control nodes, technical methods such as the correlation between the physical address of the measurement and control node and the CAN bus ID number are adopted to realize the safety monitoring of various environmental parameters and execution equipment in the pipe gallery.

articleTitle: Research on Flyback Converter Based on BP Neural Network PID Adaptive Control
publicationTitle: 2021 4th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Aiming at the control strategy of digital switching power supply, BP neural network was added to optimize the control strategy based on the traditional peak current double closed-loop control strategy. Taking flyback converter as the research object, BP neural network is used to optimize the adjustment time and recovery speed of control, so as to improve the control performance and output performance of digital switching power supply system. Finally, MATLAB/Simulink simulation shows that the PID control with BP neural network makes the output voltage have faster response speed, smaller output ripple and stronger anti-interference ability compared with the traditional peak current double closed-loop PID control.

Author Keywords: Flyback converter peak current Double closed loop BP neural network PID

articleTitle: Layout Optimization of Manufacturing Workshop Based on System Analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 4th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: The proposal of Industry 4.0 has started a new round of industrial revolution, and there are still some small manufacturing enterprises with vague production modes. In order to make the small manufacturing industry better transition to the advanced manufacturing mode, this paper takes the production line of a plate processing workshop as an example, through systematic analysis, investigates the process flow and production layout of the production site, and points out the existing problems in the production site, aiming at improving the production efficiency. Based on the ideas of ECRS and lean production, the optimization scheme is put forward from the aspects of production line layout, buffer setting and path optimization. Finally, the simulation software is used for simulation modeling. The simulation results show that, after the improvement, the production capacity and personnel utilization rate of the production line are significantly improved, and the output of products A, B and C are increased by 45.14%, 40.06% and 58.90%, respectively, reaching the expected target and improving the market competitiveness.

articleTitle: Fuzzy-Feedforward PID control of micro gas turbine
publicationTitle: 2021 4th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: In order to improve the dynamic performance of micro gas turbine under variable operating conditions, a fuzzy-feedforward PID control strategy is proposed. Firstly, the mathematical model of micro gas turbine is established according to the idea of modular modeling, and feedforward/fuzzy/fuzzy-feedforward PID controllers are designed for speed control. The designed controllers are compared with the traditional PID controller. The simulation results show that the fuzzy-feedforward PID controller has smaller speed overshoot, shorter stabilization time and faster fuel flow response.

articleTitle: Planning and Analysis of Flexible Production Line Based on Simulation
publicationTitle: 2021 4th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: The planning and design of traditional production lines rely too much on experience and manual calculus. Facing the flexible production line of small batch and multi variety precision parts processing production mode, it is impossible to carry out rapid, scientific and effective design, and the design results are difficult to achieve the expected results. Firstly, the simulation technology of production line planning is studied in this paper. On this basis, the operation process, line layout and logistics scheme of the flexible production line are planned. Then, the simulation model of production line is constructed by simulation software. Finally, the production capacity and bottleneck, equipment utilization and production efficiency of the production line are analyzed, which provides a technical basis for the planning and design of the flexible production line. And the correctness of the design scheme is proved.

articleTitle: Optimal path planning of mobile robot based on improved ant colony algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 4th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: In the current research field of mobile robots, optimal path planning is a hot topic. Ant colony algorithm is diffusely used in mobile robot path planning because of its its positive feedback, distributed and so on. However, traditional basic ant colony algorithm has some disadvantages, such as easy local convergence, slow search convergence rate and low efficiency. To solve these problems, this paper proposes an improved ant colony algorithm. Based on the algorithm principle, a new method for global pheromone initialization is put forward by improving and optimizing the pheromone mechanism, and there is a certain probability to carry out “variation” operation in each search iteration process. Meanwhile, the calculation method of heuristic function is improved to reduce the possibility of premature convergence of the algorithm falling into local optimum. The two-dimensional space model of mobile robot is created by grid method. Then they are simulated and tested respectively, and the test results are compared and analyzed. The experimental results show that the improved algorithm can obviously optimize the defects of the original algorithm, which not only can plan the path faster, but also can plan the better path, and the search efficiency has been significantly improved.

articleTitle: A emergency power equipment design of direct current full hydraulic tunnel for coal mine
publicationTitle: 2021 4th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: In the case of a coal mine power failure, the hydraulic equipment is stuck and cannot be reset in the working state. There is a problem of potential safety hazards, and to meet the short-term operation requirements of hydraulic equipment in the coal mine roadway where there is no power source. The hydraulic tunnel emergency power device is used to solve the confusion encountered in the process of underground coal mine construction. In the device design process, the explosion-proof lead-acid battery pack and inverter were optimized, the working principle of the inverter was analyzed, and the hydraulic pump station, control console and walking mechanism were designed. Finally, the feasibility and the feasibility of the hydraulic power device were verified through experiments. Promotion should be the case.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of Space-borne Ring Antenna Mechanism for Deployment Smoothness
publicationTitle: 2021 4th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Space deployable antenna is prone to failure during deployment, resulting in mission failure. Deployment smoothness is the critical factor for the success of antenna deployment. To improve the deployment smoothness of space deployable antenna and increase the deployment success rate, a scissors telescopic vertical rod loop truss deployable antenna mechanism is proposed. The basic composition and deployment process of the mechanism are introduced in detail. The kinematics and dynamics of the mechanism are analyzed. The results show that when the driving force of the same size is given, the deployment angular velocity and angular acceleration of the mechanism are significantly lower than those of Astromesh antenna. Thirdly, it is recognized that the whole deployment process of the antenna has an obvious time history, a smoothness index based on the whole time history is proposed, and the deployment smoothness of the antenna is evaluated. The results show that when the driving force of the same size is given, the acceleration root mean square of each node of the mechanism is half of that of Astromesh antenna. Finally, the prototype is developed and the rationality of the structure and accuracy of the evaluation method is verified by the antenna deployment test. The scissors telescopic vertical rod loop truss deployable antenna has a low fold/deploy ratio and a smooth foldable and deployable process.

articleTitle: Design of Virtual Training System for Virtual Reality Intelligent Production Line of Optical Fiber Router Based on Industrial Robot
publicationTitle: 2021 4th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: The industrial robot is applied to the quality inspection line of the router. The structure of the whole system takes “industry 4.0” as the background, applies a large number of modern intelligent equipment, and carries out the design and research of the virtual training system of the optical fiber router Virtual Reality intelligent production line based on the industrial robot in combination with the cutting-edge intelligent robot technology, visual inspection, radio frequency and other technologies. The assembly line is composed of industrial robot ABB 120, infrared sensor, pressure sensor, pneumatic mechanical device, conveyor belt transmission device, etc. the functions of each device are displayed by virtual simulation. The quality inspection automation solution of virtual router can simulate the production line, adjust the working parameters, explore the capacity mode of optical power detection production line, and build a training platform for colleges and universities in line with the learning environment and acceptance mode of students, so as to replace manual operation, reduce the staffing, and increase the detection efficiency and stability of detection quality.

articleTitle: Design of a magnetic gear reducer
publicationTitle: 2021 4th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Compared with traditional mechanical gears, magnetic gears have the advantages of no friction, low noise and low vibration. Although magnetic gear has a wide development prospect, there are few research papers on magnetic gear reducers. The calculation formula of the transmission torque is also more complicated, and there is a certain degree of error. This paper designs a magnetic gear reducer. Firstly, the transmission principle and characteristics of magnetic gear reducer are analyzed. Then the torque calculation formula is deduced and simplified. The three-dimensional model is constructed and the relevant simulation analysis is completed. Finally, the physical construction and experimental analysis are completed, and it is applied to the common life scenes of tower cranes, which proved the practical feasibility of the design.

articleTitle: The Cracking Rectification of Condenser Bracket Base on Finite Element
publicationTitle: 2021 4th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: The condenser brackets of light truck cracked in the road durability process of Xiang-yang national test site. In order to solve the cracking problem with computer aided engineering (CAE), the finite element modal benchmarking was carried out with the test mode firstly. Then, the cracking was reproduced with the acceleration road spectrum to prove that resonance was the main cause of cracking. On the basis of thinning bracket thickness, the optimization scheme was put forward and passed the bench test and the road durable test successfully. It not only solved the cracking fault, but also realized lightweight of the bracket, showing the accuracy and finiteness of the analysis method.

articleTitle: Research on fault diagnosis of double-column roadway stacker based on deep learning
publicationTitle: 2021 4th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: In terms of the complex data collection of various systems in the state monitoring of complex mechanical equipment in the double-column road-type stacker, the manual extraction of fault features relying on expert knowledge, the difficulty of fault pattern recognition and the weak generalization, etc. Based on the classic convolutional neural network GoogLeNet, it is aimed at the one-dimensional original the signal constructs a one-dimensional convolutional neural network fault diagnosis model. The model uses a one-dimensional convolution kernel to improve the Inception module to increase the flexible classification output of the fully connected layer, and increase the regularization and dropout processing. Different from the traditional intelligent diagnosis method through the two-stage processing mode of manual feature extraction and fault classification, this model has one-dimensional original signal adaptive feature learning, avoiding original signal preprocessing, and realizing fault diagnosis efficiently and accurately. Through the real machine health status detection experiment of the laneway stacker in the double-column road-type stacker, through the data dimensionality reduction and visualization processing and the multi-class confusion matrix results, by comparing the results of other network models in the same test set, it is proved that the model is highly accurate and effective in rapid fault diagnosis.

articleTitle: The finite element analysis of telescopic boom of forklift used in coal mine
publicationTitle: 2021 4th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Pro/E software is used to construct a three-dimensional model of the telescopic boom of a forklift for coal mines, and the modal analysis module of ANSYS finite element calculation software is used to analyze the telescopic boom of the forklift under the full extension working condition, and the $0 \sim 300$ Hz under the full extension working condition is obtained. The modal parameters of each order of the inner telescopic arm are determined, the first few natural frequencies and modes of the model are determined, and the modes of each order are analyzed and topology optimization design, which provides a reference for the performance analysis and optimization design of the whole machine. And the basis will be of certain significance to improve the operation performance, the efficiency of loading and unloading, and the mode of transportation.

articleTitle: Research on High Speed Machining Programming Technology the Whole Impeller
publicationTitle: 2021 4th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: The differences of high speed machining programming and general machining programming and the strategy of HSM programming are discussed in this paper, and the procedure of NC program in the PowerMill is analyzed. At the same time, According to the actual engineering data, the modeling of the integral impeller is realized in the Pro/E based on the analysis of the modeling of the integral impeller, then the tool path of the whole impeller is analyzed and studied, and the machining simulation of it is done in the PowerMill. At last, HSM programming of the whole impeller is finished in the PowerMill, and the reference to HSM programming is provided.

articleTitle: Fatigue reliability analysis of all electric drive shale gas fracturing vehicle frame
publicationTitle: 2021 4th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Fracturing truck is an important part of all electric drive shale gas stimulation system. As the main bearing structure of fracturing truck, the frame bears complex loads, and its fatigue life determines reliability of the system. Taking the frame of 7000hp full electric drive fracturing truck as the research object, this paper establishes the finite element simulation model of the frame, determines the load spectrum of the frame, analyzes the transient stress of the frame, and then calculates the fatigue life of the frame by using S-N curve analysis method and fatigue cumulative damage theory.

articleTitle: Research on Robust Navigation Algorithm for Soft Landing of Small Celestial Body
publicationTitle: 2021 4th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Based on the application background of autonomous navigation for soft landing of small celestial bodies, this paper proposes a robust navigation algorithm for the difficult problems of soft landing of small celestial bodies with strong uncertainty and high requirements for the accuracy and real-time performance of autonomous navigation algorithms. Small celestial bodies are far away from the earth, and the observation information is insufficient. It is difficult to establish an accurate gravitational field model. The robust navigation algorithm integrates optical navigation information and inertial navigation information to improve the accuracy and robustness of the navigation system. Experimental results show that the algorithm can reduce the impact of model uncertainty, effectively improve the accuracy of navigation and positioning, and provide a feasible method for the soft landing of the probe on the surface of small celestial bodies.

articleTitle: Thermodynamic Simulation and Analysis of Aeronautical Servo Actuator
publicationTitle: 2021 4th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: How different cooling structures influence the temperature of actuator and its sensor, piston rod, cylinder barrel in an aero-engine environment is presented in this paper. The actuator in the aero-engine environment is always at a high temperature. However, high temperature will make the sensor doesn’t work. Adding a cooling structure for the actuator will lower its temperature. According to the result of survey, three kinds of actuators are constructed: actuator without cooling structure, actuator with non-annular cooling structure, and actuator with annular cooling structure. The finite element analysis method is used to simulate the above three kinds of actuators under extreme working conditions. Through the analysis of the simulation results, it is found that cooling structure has a good cooling effect on the actuator and its sensor, piston rod, cylinder barrel. And the annular cooling structure has a better effect. This will provide theoretical fundament for the design of cooling structure of the actuator in an aero-engine environment.

articleTitle: Digital automatic control precision assembly technology
publicationTitle: 2021 4th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: At present, the interference couple parts are assembled manually which not only has a long assembly cycle, but also has uneven assembly quality according to personal ability. Combined with the current production situation, this paper studies the measurement method of motor keyway width accurately calculates the overall dimensions of keyway and flat key & calculates the appropriate interference range. Design the flat key press fitting tooling in a narrow space to effectively solve the reliable method of press fitting interference coupling parts. The press fitting force is calculated theoretically which is supplemented by simulation analysis.the range of the actual press fitting force is obtained by using the automatic control digital press fitting technology, so as to realize the precision assembly of the interference couple. Through the research of this paper, the effectiveness of precision assembly technology of automatic control digital interference couple is verified.

articleTitle: Mechanical structure design of compact intelligent dustbin
publicationTitle: 2021 4th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Aiming at the low efficiency of manual garbage classification, a compact four-classification intelligent garbage bin is designed. The functions of the garbage bin is composed of a rotating wheel structure, a turntable structure and steering gear transmission structure. According to the size of the garbage that can be contacted in the current life, the data parameters inside the garbage bin are determined, the space is used reasonably, and the compactness of the garbage bin is improved. The turntable structure and the rotating plate complete the motion segmentation through the independent rotation of the inner and outer shafts of the roller, thus realizing the automatic garbage classification and greatly improving the throwing speed of garbage classification.

articleTitle: Study on intelligent control of harvester hydraulic leveling
publicationTitle: 2021 4th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: For the problem that the current harvester is prone to roll over during work, this paper studies the hydraulic leveling of the harvester. The control model of the leveling hydraulic cylinder of the harvester is first established. Then, the coupling and coupling operations in the leveling process are analyzed. Finally, the road incentive of the harvester is analyzed, and a feasible set of harvester hydraulic leveling models is obtained.

articleTitle: A Controllable Stiffness Robotics for Natural Orifice Transluminal Endoscopic Surgery
publicationTitle: 2021 4th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Natural orifice transluminal endoscopic surgery is a new minimally invasive surgery, with no surface scars, less postoperative pain, short recovery time, less postoperative morbidity and other advantages, is the development direction of minimally invasive surgery in the future. In order to smoothly pass through the natural orifice of the human body, its surgical instruments use flexible instruments, which leads to the lack of operation force during the operation, and the safety of the operation cannot be guaranteed. In this paper, a flexible robot with controllable stiffness is designed to solve the problem of insufficient stiffness of flexible surgical instruments. According to the method of wire tensioning and variable stiffness, a miniature natural cavity surgical robot variable stiffness joint is designed. According to the mechanical limit, its motion ability is analyzed. The principle of variable stiffness of tensioned variable stiffness joint is analyzed, and the solution equation of friction moment of variable stiffness joint is derived. Finally, the relationship between tension force and stiffness is verified by experiments. The maximum static load test was carried out and the invisible variable load range of the joints with variable stiffness was obtained under certain tension conditions.

articleTitle: Research and Design of Kinematics Characteristics of Molded Sole Inspection End-effector
publicationTitle: 2021 4th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Based on the multi-color shoe molding robot, the kinematics characteristics of the robot inspection end-effector were investigated by analyzing the expression of the reference point of the end-effector in the local coordinate system and the motion logic relationship by using local coordinate system and global coordinate system transformation. By using backtracking method, a mathematical model for checking the trajectory of end-effector is derived, and its velocity and acceleration are analyzed. Furthermore, this method is applied to the wrist and arm to obtain the kinematic characteristics of the key parts of the robot. A case study shows that this method is convenient and practical to study and determine the motion characteristics of the robot, and it is convenient to grasp the local key details and the overall macro state, so as to ensure the optimal kinematic characteristics and motion function of the robot. Finally, when a point in the end-effector coordinate system is in the first stage, the inertia force on the big arm and forearm is small, the balance of the component is good, and the acceleration is in the ideal range. And the current study combines the kinematic analysis with concrete multi-color sole molding process and production rhythm requirements, in order to provide theoretical basis for the subsequent optimal design and control system of the robot.

articleTitle: Design of Intelligent Trash Can Based on STC89C54 Microcontroller Unit
publicationTitle: 2021 4th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Through the analysis of the common types of trash can and considering the shortcomings of traditional trash can in garbage classification, this paper designs a safe and energy-saving intelligent trash can based on STC89C54 Microcontroller Unit (MCU) as microprocessor. The trash can is underpinned by six modules: solar power supply module, infrared detection module, key module, ultrasonic ranging module, temperature detection module and display module. It carries a controllable telescopic cutter which is convenient for opening the sealing film of the beverage cup, with a view to realize the automatic opening and closing of the trash can cover, equipped with the functions of real-time measurement, display and alarm of the height and temperature of garbage in the trash can. Compared with the traditional trash can, its functions are comprehensive and easy to realize, with a good application prospect.

articleTitle: Structure Design and Manufacture of Thermal Car
publicationTitle: 2021 4th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Reasonable obstacle avoidance loop is drawn according to the position of obstacle piles on the site of the 7th National Engineering Training Comprehensive Ability Competition. Geometric model of motion is established, and the corner of each position of car is obtained through path point set. Contour design and trajectory simulation of cam is based on MATLAB. The three-dimensional model is established by SolidWorks, and the cam shape is corrected by motion analysis. Experiments show that the thermal car designed by intelligent manufacturing technology can meet the needs of changeable trajectory. This paper provides an idea for the design of thermal car with intelligent technology, and hopes to give relevant personnel reference.

articleTitle: Dimension reduction of inverse kinematics of seven-degree-of-freedom manipulator based on pose separation method
publicationTitle: 2021 4th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: The seven-degree-of-freedom robotic arm has the flexibility to avoid obstacles due to its high degree of freedom, but it is also structurally redundant by one degree of freedom, which makes its kinematic solution more difficult. The seven-degree-of-freedom robotic arm studied in this paper satisfies the Pieper criterion, the last three joint axes intersect at a point, so the inverse kinematics can be solved by using the bit-pose separation method for position and pose inversion. But since the solution of the first four joints still requires complex fourth-order chi-square transformation matrix operations, this paper proposes a method combining the bit-pose separation method and dimensionality reduction for the inverse solution, which simplifies the operations to a certain extent. The simulation results are verified by the robotics toolbox in MATLAB. The simulation results verify the correctness of the inverse solution method and the time consumption of the operation.

articleTitle: Construction truck wheel loader driving and parking integral afterburner pump
publicationTitle: 2021 4th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: The basic structure and function of integral afterburner pump for running and stopping function of wheel loader of engineering car are described.The braking system is simple, reliable, compact and easy to maintain, thus reducing the cost.

articleTitle: Research on Task Scheduling Algorithm Based on Multi-Time Period Merging
publicationTitle: 2021 4th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Task scheduling algorithm is an important component of production task scheduling system. At present, the task scheduling system has some problems related to urgent task scheduling time and complex scheduling logic. Therefore, it is necessary for the task scheduling algorithm to consider the scheduling time and study the logic of the algorithm to ensure the efficient and orderly completion of the scheduling tasks. To solve these problems, this paper proposes a Time Merging Earliest Deadline First (TEDF) algorithm based on the integration of multiple time periods by merging the current time, execution time and task deadline time, which can improve the timeliness of the real-time task scheduling system. In the production task set, the tasks with high static priority are executed first, and in the same priority task queue, the task with the shortest waiting time is executed first as well. The simulation experiment results show that if the task deadline is sufficient, the total waiting time of the tasks processed by the TEDF algorithm is less than that of the ordinary queuing algorithm and the EDF algorithm; if the deadline is limited, the number of timeout tasks and important tasks generated by TEDF algorithm are less than that of ordinary queuing algorithm, which proves that TEDF algorithm can better solve the problems existing in the task scheduling system and has strong robustness.

articleTitle: Simulation and Optimization Analysis of Vehicle Cooling System
publicationTitle: 2021 4th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: At all stages of automotive product development, it is very important to estimate and optimize cooling system performance. The simulation analysis is efficient and accurate, which can provide the optimal scheme, better guide system design and development, improve research and development efficiency, shorten development cycle and cost, and enhance the performance and reliability of cooling system. In this paper, by means of CAE, a cooling system model of a certain automobile is established by using flowmaster, carried out the steady-state simulation calculation under different working conditions. The results of the original scheme show that when the temperature difference of radiator meets the requirements, the flow and temperature rise of the cabin heater and HP EGR cooler does not meet the requirements of the specification, and the system pressure loss is too large. The optimization scheme suggests that the oil cooler and the air compressor are arranged in parallel. When the flow rate and temperature rise meet the requirements, it is recommended to increase the pump capacity to 220L/min@2.2bar.

articleTitle: Research on optimization of dispensing process of a Chinese medicine granule dispensing equipment based on improved genetic algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 4th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) culture has been handed down to the present, and it plays a huge role in both treatment and prevention with few side effects. The development from Chinese medicine decoction pieces to Chinese medicine granules provides conditions for automatic dispensing. There are still some problems due to the huge dispensing system and the wide range of technologies involved. For example, path planning is also a key point in Chinese medicine granules dispensing process. A good algorithm can greatly improve Chinese medicine granules dispensing efficiency. Aiming at the dispensing order problem of a Chinese medicine granule dispensing equipment, the dispensing process was transformed into traveling salesman problem (TSP). This paper presents an improved genetic algorithm that is applied to the dispensing process planning. Genetic algorithm (GA) as the core, this paper introduces the basic principle of genetic algorithm. Selection and mutation operation are analyzed and an improved genetic algorithm is proposed. Finally to a Chinese medicine granule dispensing equipment as an instance. Analysis the dispensing process. Simulate the dispensing process. The results show that compared with the traditional genetic algorithm, the improved genetic algorithm can reduce the number of iterations and improve the dispensing efficiency, which has certain advantages.

articleTitle: Manufacturing heterojunction based on 2D materials for artificial neural network construction
publicationTitle: 2021 4th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Artificial neural network is an abstract and simplified computing structure that simulates the neural system of human brain and reflects some characteristics of human brain. Artificial nerve is favored by researchers because of its high efficiency, memory function and fast calculation. Constructing artificial nerve and synapse to simulate biological nerve and synapse puts forward higher requirements for the structure and properties of the required materials. The development and application of synaptic devices made of traditional block materials are limited due to the defects of strong scattering and relatively large space. Due to the characteristics of high carrier mobility, dangling bonding free surface and nanocrystallization of emerging two-dimensional (2D) materials, heterojunctions are widely used in the functional realization experiments of artificial neurons and synapses. The successful application of 2D heterojunction in artificial neural network also has a far-reaching impact on the development of artificial intelligence and intelligent manufacturing. In this review, firstly, the types of 2D materials and the advantages of 2D materials as new materials for constructing artificial neurons and synapses are summarized. Then, the working principles of biological neurons and synapses, artificial neurons and synapses are briefly described, and the applications of heterojunctions based on 2D materials in artificial synapses (neurons) are summarized. Finally, the prospect of 2D material heterojunction in the field of artificial neural research and the possible challenges are analyzed.

articleTitle: Research on Switch with Locking Device
publicationTitle: 2021 4th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: for normal switch, knob can rotate with force to different positions which correspond to different output functions. But for some functions, misoperate are not allowed, such as for anti-aircraft light switch on military vehicles, there is light control function for civil vehicles, and also request light control function in air defense mode in combat. This study describes a switch with locking device whose different gear corresponding to different output function and the switch is able to change at will between two or more modes, of which has the function of interlocking and can prevent misoperation. The paper analyzes and discusses from different switch aspects, including automobile electrical appliance, anti-aircraft light switch for military vehicle, the locking device and so on<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">[3]</sup>.

articleTitle: Multi-parameter Discrete Grey Prediction With Few Observations
publicationTitle: 2021 4th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: The fault prediction of weapon is getting more difficult for its complex structure, unique operating environment and multi-plicate faults. Currently although the main fault prediction methods have achieved certain success in practical application, they all fall short in some aspects. Based on the discrete grey prediction theory and with an analysis of the disadvantages of the discrete grey model, an adaptive prediction model with several characteristic parameters for small samples is proposed. This model modifies the initial value and takes into account the interrelations of the parameters and characteristics of prediction series. The data of a certain aircraft engine are taken as an example for prediction and analysis, and the results showed that the model had high availability and precision.

articleTitle: Vibration characteristics of High-speed EMU considering car body structural vibration mode
publicationTitle: 2021 4th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: In order to research the vibration characteristics of high-speed EMU under different typical excitation, taking a aluminum alloy body of a certain high-speed EMU as an example, the finite element model of car body is established, then the rigid-flexible coupling dynamic model of vehicle-track system is established after modal analysis, considering the first 10 vibration modes of the car body, the wheel diameter difference and wheel polygon, the dynamic model’s vibration response under different combined excitation is simulated and analyzed. The results show that comparing with the rigid model, the finite element model reflects the vibration characteristics of high-speed EMU more accurately.the lateral Riding Index would worsen while increasing the running speed and wavelength of short wave irregularity. The wheel diameter difference will aggravate the vibration response of each component, the effect of the one in the same phase is the most obvious. The vertical acceleration of the wheelset would exacerbate as the order and amplitude of wheel polygon increase, and the effect of wheel polygon amplitude is more obvious.

articleTitle: Analysis of The Influence of Punching Speed on Die Wear Based on DEFORM
publicationTitle: 2021 4th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: This paper uses DEFORM simulation software, based on the Cockcroft Latham fracture criterion, to simulate and analyze the punching process of the workpiece, and obtain the stress, load, die wear and maximum wear rate during the punching process. Under the condition of a single variable, the punching process is simulated and the influence of punching speed on wear is studied. When the punching speed is between 25 mm/s and 50 mm/s, the wear shows a certain increasing trend.

articleTitle: Study on negative pressure handling of carbon fiber prepreg
publicationTitle: 2021 4th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: In the handling and transferring process of carbon fiber prepreg during the automatic forming application, the analysis of the sucker’s position and diameter in the negative pressure handling process is often ignored. Given the hanging quality analysis in the handling process, the classical laminate theory is usually used to deal with the prepreg. It is challenging to get the actual simulation results. Based on the constitutive model of fabric, this paper further analyzed the constitutive model suitable for prepreg material and analyzed the handling quality of prepreg material under different sucker diameters and spacing through experiments and simulations to provide a more reasonable sucker size and layout strategy for handling and transferring prepreg material in the automatic forming process. It can be found that the larger the diameter of the sucker, the smaller the maximum overhang, but the more significant the reverse deformation of prepreg at the sucker position. The hanging quality of prepreg will be improved when the distance between suction cups decreases.

articleTitle: Tool Wear Monitoring of Milling Center Based on Optimize Variational Mode Decomposition
publicationTitle: 2021 4th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: The tool wear monitoring of milling center is of great significance to reduce downtime and ensure quality of workpieces. A new method has been developed to classify tool wear based on vibration signals of milling process. The parameters of revised variational mode decomposition are selected by quantum genetic algorithm. The vibration signals of milling process are analyzed by the revised variational mode decomposition and classified by the gradient boosting decision tree algorithm. The comparison results indicate that the proposed method is an efficient method for tool wear monitoring of milling center.

articleTitle: NR-MNPE based ship gear fault detection
publicationTitle: 2021 4th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Marine gearbox is the main propulsion drive of ship power system, and accurate fault detection is important to improve the stability of ship power system. Aiming at the current problems of marine gearbox fault detection with low accuracy and ignoring the influencing factors such as actual noise, this paper proposes an improved marine gearbox fault detection method (NR-MNPE) by improving the local feature mining of the Neighborhood Preserving Embedding (NPE) algorithm and combining it with wavelet noise reduction. Further, for the shortage of NPE feature extraction, distance reconstruction of the neighborhood set is adopted to correct the problem of insufficient extraction caused by inconsistent dimensional scales of each variable during feature extraction. The effectiveness of the algorithm is experimentally verified by the vibration and fault simulation experimental platform (opzz) of rotating machinery. The study aims to promote the development of science and technology in this field as a way to serve the benign development of industrial society.

articleTitle: Research on Regenerative Braking Distribution Method of Pure Electric Vehicle Based on Firefly Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 4th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: New energy vehicles account for more and more in today's domestic market, and the energy recovery of regenerative braking is one of the key directions of new energy vehicles research, has great research significance. In this paper, the braking process and the driving system of a certain type of front-drive pure electric vehicle were analyzed, and the objective function for the braking safety and optimal energy recovery of the vehicle was constructed respectively. Meanwhile, the areas of three braking conditions were planned with MATLAB, providing theoretical basis for firefly algorithm to optimize the boundary. Secondly, Simulink modeling was carried out on the selected vehicle. On the existing vehicle model, a regenerative braking allocation strategy based on firefly optimization algorithm was proposed by using the constructed optimization objective function and firefly optimization strategy iteration, and simulation was carried out under ECE conditions. The results show that the proposed algorithm can improve the SOC surplus of pure electric vehicles and has practical value.

articleTitle: Curve fitting and software realization of electronic cam
publicationTitle: 2021 4th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Compared with the traditional mechanical cam mechanism, which has the disadvantages of low efficiency and high noise, the electronic cam has more powerful functions, can realize the complex process, and greatly improves the flexibility, accuracy and speed of the interpolation movement. In order to realize the interpolation movement. It adopt the way of Ethercat soft master station, control the servo drive; Under the CSP movement control mode. It control the slave axis synchronous movement so as to realize the differential control of multi-axis linkage. The interpolation motion of electronic cam is more stable under the cam curve designed by quintic polynomial interpolation theory.

articleTitle: Research on the Structure Compensation Technology of Multiple Parallel Mechanisms for Large Antenna Array
publicationTitle: 2021 4th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: The radar antenna is developing in the direction of high precision, high gain and large aperture. It puts forward higher requirements for the flatness and attitude of antenna array. For the large antenna arrays, due to the limitation of processing equipment, assembly accuracy and load deformation, the flatness and attitude of antenna array are difficult to meet the requirements of electrical performance. This paper presents a new type of multi parallel adjustment structural compensation technology. The technology combines the antenna with the 6-DOF parallel mechanism platform. An antenna array precision control system based on multi parallel mechanism is developed. Through the verification of the experimental prototype, the antenna array can be controlled with high precision, and the flatness and attitude of the antenna array can be adjusted to meet the target requirements by controlling the motion of the parallel adjusting mechanism, and the effectiveness of the structure compensation method is

articleTitle: Research on motion control of mobile robot based on S-type acceleration and deceleration
publicationTitle: 2021 4th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Under the control of ultrasonic admittance, the robot needs real-time speed control in its working process. The quality of speed control will directly affect the motion accuracy and stability of the robot. In this paper, a speed regulation method of robot based on S-type acceleration and deceleration is proposed for obstacle avoidance planning. First of all, using the method of ultrasonic real-time detection and admittance control control the speed of the robot after entering the obstacle avoidance range. At a certain distance from the obstacle, using the improved bug algorithm walk around the detected object contour to bypass him. And at the distance X from the turning point, the robot smooth control algorithm based on S-type acceleration and deceleration is used to achieve a smooth transition of the speed at the turning point. Through experimental simulation, the speed stability and obstacle avoidance trajectory of the robot based on S-type acceleration and deceleration under the control of admittance have been significantly improved.

articleTitle: The Path Planning of Grinding and Polishing for Wind-driven Generator Vane Based on Curvature Gradient and Shortest Route
publicationTitle: 2021 4th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: The huge vane of wind-driven generator plays a key role in power generation, and thevane working surface is the key to the performance in the core role of it. The working vane in dimension may be more than 100m in length and more than 5m in width. The grinding and polishing of its surface become the technical bottleneck. Based on the actual situation of the generator, the geometric characteristics of the working surface, and the variation rule of the vane contour, the matching of path planning of the tool head to the optimal technological parameters was developed according to the objective of shortest production time with constraints of both minimum curvature gradient and shortest route under equilibrium-working pressure of the tool head. The vane was divided into several sub-working regions for concrete geometric characteristics by using defferentiation-calculus principle. The horizontal ridge was determined and the horizontal ridge line was used as the reference for curvature of the surface and several planes parallel to the horizontal ridge line was used to have sectional lines on which the feature points were selected and the curvature of the working curve was calculated. The curvature sets of all sub-working domains were combined to form the global vane curvature matrix. According to the principle of minimum curvature gradient and avoidance of the repetition of working route, the grinding and polishing plan with the shortest path or the shortest time is determined among the feasible route.

articleTitle: Design of ICRD multifunctional cold water recovery system based on the Internet of Things technology
publicationTitle: 2021 4th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: In order to solve the problems of early cold water recycling of traditional water heater, single function and poor use experience, a cold water recovery system with hot water return, temperature regulation and private customization is designed. The system uses S TM32 single chip machine as the control core, and through clever mechanical design realizes cold water recovery through the cold water recovery module, remote control module and hot water temperature control module. At the same time, for the system developed a special App, water heater, faucet and bathroom lighting linkage, using a mobile phone can control the water heater water temperature, flow speed, bathroom lighting atmosphere, bath center, and so on, so can greatly improve the user water experience, in line with the concept of smart home, improve water utilization, promote the development of resource-saving society.

articleTitle: Study on compressive properties of fiber metal laminates with nail reinforced structure
publicationTitle: 2021 4th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Fiber metal laminate (FML) are widely used in aerospace and other fields because of their excellent mechanical properties, such as high specific strength, high specific stiffness. However, due to their relatively poor interlaminar properties, the further application of FML was limited. In the paper, a fiber metal laminate with embedded nail structure was designed, and the samples were prepared based on 3D printing technology. Through experimental research and finite element simulation, the mechanical properties of fiber metal laminate with nail structure under compressive load were analyzed. By reasonably setting the number and height of nail structure, the delamination damage could be restrained and the mechanical properties of members could be improved.

articleTitle: Design of dynamic data acquisition system based on mechanical fault diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2021 4th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: With the wide application of computer and microelectronics in the field of mechanical fault diagnosis, the combination of data acquisition system, sensor and analysis and processing system becomes more and more close.
