Based on the working principle and parameter selection of NI-DAQ data acquisition board, the paper integrates hardware acquisition equipment and application software through computer to establish a complete set of practical instruments and equipment and dynamic data acquisition system, so as to realize the solution of obtaining information with high speed, high precision and multi-channel. The data acquisition can realize data acquisition, integration and storage, and provide important data basis for subsequent fault diagnosis and analysis. The veracity of data collected by the system is verified by vibration test.

articleTitle: Research on Trajectory Planning of Numerical Control Drilling for Panel Furniture Based on Elite Ant Colony Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 4th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: By analyzing the objectives of trajectory planning an optimization method based on the elite ant colony algorithm has been proposed which is aiming at the trajectory planning problem of numerical control drilling for panel furniture. The optimization algorithm can avoid entering local optimum and is suitable for integration with machining center software. Through simulation analysis and solution the elite ant colony algorithm method can reduce the drillling path step by 10.8% compared with the empirical law. After the simulation processing by using the numerical control drilling software it shows that the optimization algorithm can effectively improve the drilling production efficiency.

articleTitle: Research on Exhaust Steam Temperature Automatic Control of Ultra-supercritical Unit
publicationTitle: 2021 4th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Nowadays, more than 100 ultra-supercritical units have been put into operation. During the operation of ultra-supercritical units, the exhaust steam temperature often rises too fast, but traditional control strategy can’t effectively control temperature. As a result, the exhaust steam temperature is too high to trigger the turbine trip protection. This paper introduces the exhaust steam temperature automatic control strategy of ultra-supercritical unit. It analyzes the difficulty of temperature limiter control and cutting cylinder protection control, and it discovers the hidden danger of this strategy when the unit running under high loads. In order to avoid the hidden danger, the exhaust steam control optimization is carried out in this paper, and good application effect is achieved. The results show that the optimization strategy has high application value.

articleTitle: Design of a new tubular structure transfer tool
publicationTitle: 2021 4th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Tubular precision manufacturing products have high production cost and machining accuracy of shape and position tolerance. Once the protection is inadequate in the process of transfer and transportation, it is easy to produce transportation variation, resulting in unqualified products. In particular, the precision manufactured products are removed from the wooden box and other protective devices to the assembly site. In view of the weak protection consciousness of the operators and the complex site environment, often in the process of transfer and transportation, the energy is insufficient, resulting in insufficient protection of cylindrical precision manufactured products in this process. For the safe transfer of cylindrical precision manufacturing products, it is necessary to avoid direct rigid contact and adapt to complex assembly site environment. In the process of transfer and transportation, vibration and impact should be reduced to avoid sudden braking and sharp turning, so as to effectively reduce the vibration acceleration of cylindrical precision manufacturing products and ensure their safety. Therefore, a new type of transfer vehicle with tubular structure is proposed in this paper. It has the advantages of shock absorption and buffering, wide application range, high adaptability to complex road conditions, multi-use, etc.

articleTitle: Optimal Design of the High Speed Blend Machine Control System
publicationTitle: 2021 4th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: The high-speed blend machine is a new type of house appliance which can produce a variety of drinks. Based on the experiences fed back by the users of the machines, it has been noticed that the peel of fruit or vegetable will be left over in the machine due to not well-designed products produced by different brands. The unsatisfactory performance in crushing the raw materials causes unpleasant flavor and taste. By analyzing the characteristics of a single-phase series motor, the load change has a greater influence on the motor speed, and the motor speed is an important factor that affects the material cell-wall breaking rate. Therefore, in this paper, we designed a fuzzy self-adaptive PID controller based on the STM32 microcontroller to perform the hardware and software design of the series motor control system of the high-speed blend machine. We carried out an experimental test to verify that the fuzzy adaptive PID controller was the feasibility of series motor speed. We designed and tested three control modes with different rotation speeds. The experiment found that there was a good crushing effect under the variable speed control mode, which provided a certain basis for the optimization of the control mode. Finally, we established a recognition equation according to the effect of different fruit or vegetable on the start-up speed of a single-phase series motor. We used the minimum mean error method to identify the material to improve the control ability of the high-speed blend machine in handling different fruit crushing processes and optimize crushing degree and crushing effect, which provided a new idea for realizing the intelligent control of house appliances.

articleTitle: Development of Static Characteristic Test System for TMR Sensors
publicationTitle: 2021 4th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Tunnel magneto-resistance (TMR) sensors have been widely used in astronautics, automotive electronics, non-destructive testing, biomedicine, etc. However, an effective characteristics test method is still awaited, which to some extent restricts further applications of TMR sensors. This paper presents a static characteristic test system based on Merritt coil. Theoretical calculation and experimental verification are carried out for the coil design. The Merritt coil can generate magnetic field of uniformity better than 1% in a large volume around the central point. The static characteristics of three selected TMR sensors are tested and analyzed. Results show that the TMR sensor has very low hysteresis, and the sensor output is linear with the cosine of the angle between the sensor sensitive axis and magnetic field direction, but the sensitivity of an individual sensor may deviate from the typical value on the datasheet.

articleTitle: Research on three dimensional measurement method based on focused evaluation
publicationTitle: 2021 4th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Focus Variation Microscopy is an important method for surface topography measurement. Focusing evaluation function, focusing evaluation window and focusing search algorithm are the main steps of focus variation microscopy, among which focusing evaluation function is the most important. In this paper, the research status and measurement principle of focus variation microscopy at home and abroad, the types of focusing evaluation function, focusing evaluation window and focusing search algorithm are introduced in detail. Finally, based on four different focusing evaluation operators, the three-dimensional morphology of the object is restored and certain effects are achieved. Of course, in the future research, the effect will be more obvious after the algorithm is improved.

articleTitle: Research Progress and Development Direction of Structural Optimization and Modeling of traveling Wave Rotating Ultrasonic Motor
publicationTitle: 2021 4th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: In order to promote the development of traveling wave type rotary supersonic motor and its application in a precision drive field, this paper briefly summarizes its development history, research and application status, and predicts the future research and development direction. This paper summarizes and analyzes the development and research status of ultrasonic motor structure improvement and mathematical modeling methods. At the same time, the technical problems that need to be further studied at present are summarized and pointed out. In addition, the current applications of traveling wave circular supersonic motors are briefly summarized in this paper. Finally, based on the systematic summary of the relevant research results, the future research and application prediction of the traveling wave type circular supersonic motors are proposed, in order to provide reference for the further research in this field.

articleTitle: Vehicle state and tire parameter estimation based on improved particle filter based on genetic algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 4th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Independent tire dynamics parameters are often determined using expensive test equipment and large amounts of test data, after which these parameters are applied in the design phase to a vehicle model to simulate the vehicle’s handling dynamics behavior. The use of particle filtering techniques enables the estimation of tire parameters and can eventually lead to the estimation of parameters such as vehicle lateral forces. The advantage of genetic algorithm in selection inheritance is used to complement the degradation of particle weights and the lack of particle diversity in particle filter resampling to achieve high accuracy identification of tire parameters.

articleTitle: Degradation feature extraction of quay side crane lifting gearbox based on Katz fractal dimensional-Singular value decomposition
publicationTitle: 2021 4th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: In order to effectively analyze the degradation state characteristics of port bridge lifting gear box, fractal theory was proposed to analyze the nonlinear vibration output signal of port machinery containing fatigue degradation law. A computational method, Katz-FD, proposed by The Master of Signal Theory and Bioengineering at valladolid University, is introduced to characterize and evaluate the health degradation of port machinery. The nonlinear vibration output signals with different fatigue damage degrees were obtained by using (port engine model). It can be seen from the evolution law of microcracks in the fatigue process that the fractal dimension eigenvalues can effectively characterize the variation law and group behavior of the nonlinear vibration signals in the fatigue process. Therefore, fractal theory can effectively analyze the degradation characteristics of port machinery in the process of health state. According to the relation of Katz-FD characteristic value of fractal theory, it provides a new analysis method for port machinery health state prediction.

articleTitle: Research on working principle and realization mode of electronic controlled air dryer
publicationTitle: 2021 4th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: In the automobile air brake system, the air compressor generates compressed air to supply the air brake system to achieve the specified control action. Because the compressed air contains moisture, small impurities and oil mist droplets, the pneumatic system of the vehicle is easy to be blocked by impurities. Small impurities, oil droplets and water in the compressed air not only pollute the pipeline of the gas brake system, but also corrode the components of the system, reducing the service life of the gas brake valve products. More seriously, when the pneumatic system is used in cold conditions, the moisture in the compressed air will condense in the channel, block the pipeline and block the action of components, resulting in system failure, reduce the reliability of the air brake system, resulting in accidents. Therefore, air dryers are usually set up in the compressed air system to remove the impurities including water, dust, oil droplets and so on. At present, the use of air dryer on the market is generally mechanical structure air dryer, air dryer exhaust unloading, molecular sieve regeneration and air dryer stop unloading, mainly through the relationship between spring force, air pressure and air pressure action area to achieve. In the process of use, due to the attenuation of the pressure regulating spring force, the performance of the air dryer changes, affecting the service life of the air dryer, resulting in complaints from users. In view of this, in view of the shortcomings of the existing technology, this paper proposes an electronic controlled air dryer, which can realize the functions of the mechanical air dryer through the solenoid valve. Its simple structure, miniaturization, lightweight, suitable for user needs. [2][4]

articleTitle: Analysis of Impact-resistant Design for Ship-borne Rigid Installed Electronic Equipment
publicationTitle: 2021 4th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: The anti-impact capability of the rigidly mounted radar antenna on the ship-borne is an important factor to determine the ship’s viability and battle effectiveness. The force model of a rigidly mounted radar antenna on ship-borne under impact load is simplified to a basic excitation multi-degree-of-freedom system, and the system response can be expressed a convolution integral of the unit pulse response and the excitation load. The unit pulse response function contains all the dynamic characteristic parameters of the system. By studying the dynamic characteristics of the frequency response function in the frequency domain, the impact response characteristics of the rigidly mounted antenna on the ship-borne are analyzed. The results show that when the weight of the antenna skeleton and the impact load acting on the antenna skeleton are certain, the impact load on the sub array first increases, then decreases, and finally tends to a fixed value as the stiffness of the antenna skeleton increases from small to large. The mass loaded on the antenna skeleton increases, which gradually affects the impact load input and reduces the input. In addition, when the antenna skeleton is close to the natural frequency of the sub-array, the response is the largest. When the impact load on the sub-array tends to a fixed value, the corresponding antenna skeleton stiffness is the best design point of the antenna skeleton stiffness. In the low frequency band, the impact load on the sub-array increases with the increase of the stiffness of the antenna skeleton and decreases with the increase of the sub-array mass. In the high frequency band, the impact load on the sub-array is independent of the stiffness of the antenna skeleton.

articleTitle: High Precision Gear Manufacturing with three Thermal Error Measuring Methods and Performance Comparison
publicationTitle: 2021 4th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: As specialized machine tools for manufacturing small-module gears, the dry gear hobbing machines are wildly used in the manufacturing industry. In this study, instead of developing mapping relation between the thermal-induced error and surface temperature change of the dry gear hobbing machine, a new direct measuring method to measure the thermal error was proposed. To quantify its application effect and its advantages over previous methods, a test platform was built and the application effects of three different methods were experimentally assessed. Experiment results showed that, with all of these three methods, the alignment errors of gears can maintain within the ninth level. However from the point of view of minimizing the alignment errors of gears, the direct measuring method seemed to be a better choice since the compensation system adopting this method can maintain the error level less than eighth during a large-volume continuous gear cutting process.

articleTitle: Study on Thermal Dynamics Modeling and Simulation of Inflatable Shock Absorber
publicationTitle: 2021 4th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Aiming at problems such as high temperature rise of the shock absorber, which may easily lead to seal damage, the mono-tube type shock absorber was the research object, and theoretical modeling study of thermodynamics was carried out. The changes in the internal energy of the system and the energy exchange with the outside world were deduced through engineering thermodynamics, and the heat transfer coefficient of each surface of the cylinder tube was derived through the theory of heat transfer, especially the analytical expression of forced convection heat dissipation was clarified. The viscosity-temperature characteristic of the oil was analyzed, and the thermal equilibrium temperature of the shock absorber and its influencing factors were simulated and analyzed through programming, which provided theoretical basis for the design and optimization of the shock absorber parameters.

articleTitle: Development of a large range piezoelectric hot stamping forming force measurement sensor
publicationTitle: 2021 4th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Hot stamping technology has broad application prospects, but its working conditions are poor. The existing research lacks the key technology of on-line monitoring of forming force, which restricts the development of this technology. Based on the piezoelectric effect of quartz crystal and offload parallel principle, a new structure of the hot stamping forming force measurement sensor is proposed. This sensor can effectively measure large-range load. ANSYS software is used for parametric modeling, and static simulation experiments is carried out. A quasi-static calibration and dynamic calibration platform was built to calibrate the designed hot stamping force measurement sensor. The theoretical analysis and simulation results show that the sensor load can reach 2000 kN. The experimental results show that the sensor load can reach 2000 kN and the natural frequency is more than 3000 Hz. The hot stamping force measurement sensor has the advantages of large bearing capacity and good dynamic performance, which promotes the automation, intelligence and industrialization of hot stamping.

articleTitle: Structural Design and Experiment of a Vertical Bicycle Parking Device Based on TRIZ Theory
publicationTitle: 2021 4th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of complicated parking process, time-consuming, inconvenient operation and high cost of vertical bicycle parking device, based on TRIZ theory, the contradiction matrix was used to find the corresponding TRIZ inventive principles. The working principle and structure for the vertical parking bicycle device were studied. A new vertical bicycle parking device was proposed. It was mainly composed of bicycle parking frame, lifting mechanism, clamping mechanism, switching mechanism and intelligent lock. The functions of automatic clamping and loosening of the front wheel of the bicycle, vertical parking and bicycle anti-theft were realized, using the force of multiple springs, linear guide and slider, lever principle and some special-shaped parts. A virtual prototype for motion simulation and stress analysis were designed by using SolidWorks to verify the rationality of structural design. The physical prototype was manufactured. The experimental results show that the device is easy to operate, the parking time is 3 ~ 5 seconds, saving about 40% parking space, lifting mechanism to help reduce energy consumption, which has a good practical value and promotion significance.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of MES system for intelligent manufacturing reducer production line
publicationTitle: 2021 4th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Through the analysis of the existing intelligent manufacturing production mode, aiming at the problem of the current mode of information exchange, we study a MES system based on the B/S architecture, and its architecture, system flow, and functional modules The design of other key technologies has effectively improved the work efficiency of the intelligent manufacturing line, solved the problems of workshop information management, and has the advantages of low cost and stable operation.

articleTitle: Numerical study of the hydrodynamic properties of a mid-water sensors mounting structure
publicationTitle: 2021 4th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: A single-point Electro-Mechanical(EM) cable subsurface mooring(EMC-SSM) is a subsea structure used in measuring a variety of ocean parameters throughout the water column continuously. A mid-water sensors mounting structure (MWSMS) is an important part of the single-point EMC-SSM and is used to mount a variety of sensors in mid-water column. This paper investigates the hydrodynamic properties of a MWSMS shape. Numerical methods for determining added mass coefficient and drag coefficient on a complex multi-component body are presented. The accuracies of numerical methods are evaluated by comparing with those of superposition methods. It is found that the accuracy of the drag coefficient is improved by about 15% in X direction, and the accuracy of the added mass coefficient is improved by 11.2% and 9% in X and Z direction respectively. These coefficients obtained by numerical methods will be used in simulating the response of a single-point EMC-SSM system.

articleTitle: Damping Analysis of Disk Resonator Gyroscope in Rarefied Gas
publicationTitle: 2021 4th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: This paper reports a high-Q MEMS disk resonator gyroscope (DRG) structure, which has lower thermoelastic damping (TED). With the high Q<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">ted</inf>, the air damping of DRG needs to be considered in design. An oscillation attenuation experiment was carried out on vacuum, which verified the importance of air damping in Q factor of DRG. The damping simulation including thermoelastic damping, anchor damping and air damping, are introduced. Based on the molecular dynamic theory, the calculation method of air damping of DRG under rarefied gas is developed, with result of simulation, the working pressure of the DRG with wafer level package using getter is 0.3Pa. Simulation results prove that optimizing air damping can further improve the performance of DRG after the thermoelastic damping reaches the design limit.

articleTitle: Technical Characteristics Analysis of Automotive Electronic Steering System
publicationTitle: 2021 4th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: The paper introduces the structure and working principle of the electronic steering system of common vehicles at present, analyzes the technical characteristics of electronic steering system, and the advantages and disadvantages of traditional mechanical hydraulic power steering system and electronic hydraulic power steering system are compared and analyzed. Hope to provide some help and technical support to the fault detection and maintenance staff of electronic steering system.

articleTitle: Resistance Response of Carbon Nanofibers to Mutiaxial Strain
publicationTitle: 2021 4th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Carbon nanofiber materials play an important role in many fields, and the research on carbon nanofiber is very extensive. In order to explore the mechanical resistance response of carbon nanofibers under axial and transverse strain, the carbon nanofibers are soaked into the resin and pasted on the surface of the structure. Then, the mechanical resistance response law of Carbon Nanofibers under several different strain states is obtained by four-point bending experiment. The experimental results show that carbon nanofibers have different sensitivity to tensile strain and compressive strain. The sensitivity coefficients to axial tensile strain and compressive strain are 11.4 and 2.1 respectively. The sensitivity coefficients to transverse tensile strain and compressive strain are 0.6 and −1.0, respectively. By using these coefficients, the sensitivity of carbon nanofibers applied to strain sensing of uniaxial stress components is deduced. The results show that the axial sensitivity of carbon nanofibers decreases with the increase of Poisson's ratio under uniaxial tensile stress and the axial sensitivity of carbon nanofibers increases with the increase of Poisson's ratio under uniaxial compressive stress.

articleTitle: Simulation of Fretting Wear on the Contact Surface between Cortical Bone and Titanium Alloy
publicationTitle: 2021 4th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Fretting usually occurs between contact surfaces, and the amplitude of mutual motion of contact surfaces is at the micron level. In this paper, the sphere-on-plate contact model of the contact surface between cortical bone and Ti-6Al-4V was established. Based on Archard wear equation, the fretting wear behavior was simulated by UMESHMOTION subroutine in ABAQUS software. The effects of fretting displacement amplitude on the surface wear process of Ti-6Al-4V was studied. It was found that the fretting slip state changed from partial slip state to gross slip state with the increase of displacement Amplitude, and the wear depth increased significantly at the same time. This study provided a theoretical basis for the study of fretting wear between titanium alloy medical devices and cortical bone.

articleTitle: Design of Quadruped Robot Articulated Motor Body
publicationTitle: 2021 4th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: The articulated motor is a significant part of the research of quadruped robots with electric drives. This article uses software simulation to study the method of design on the articular motor body, which contains the brushless permanent magnet motor of the external rotor and the NGW planetary reducer. Therefore, electromagnetic design based on motor-CAD and NGW reducer design based on Kisssoft has been completed. It is proven that the proposed design method of the motor body is feasible and reliable by the prototype.

articleTitle: Study and test of integrated performance test of intelligent management air handling system
publicationTitle: 2021 4th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: On the basis of intelligent management of air handling system assembly product performance test system and sub-module test project, a series of performance tests and test verification analysis are carried out for each sub-module of the system: ECU electronic control module, EPB parking module, integrated valve body module, drying tank unit and so on.

articleTitle: Effects of Composite Processing on Microstructures and Properties of Al-Mg Alloy
publicationTitle: 2021 4th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Aluminum-magnesium alloy is widely used at present, so it is of great significance to study its performance improvement. The effect of cold deformation plus deep cryogenic treatment on microstructures and properties of 5A06 aluminum alloy was studied. The results show that the hardness of 5A06 aluminum alloy increased with the extension of cryogenic treatment time, regardless of cold deformation. There was no linear relationship between cold deformation and hardness of the alloy when the cryogenic treatment time was constant. The best process to improve the hardness of the alloy was the combination treatment of 16% cold deformation and 72h cryogenic treatment. Under the same cold deformation conditions, the cryogenic treatment time had a significant effect on the microstructures of 5A06 aluminum alloy. With the extension of cryogenic treatment time, the amount of Al<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> Mg<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> phase in the microstructure increased obviously. The time of cryogenic treatment and the degree of cold deformation are the key factors affecting the microstructure and properties of the alloy, and the combined treatment effect depends on the influence of the two factors on the stress of the alloy.

articleTitle: A Deep Learning Method to Realize The Load Sensing Control
publicationTitle: 2021 4th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Traditional load sensing system is based on the electromechanical feedback control, which is of inferior robustness, susceptible to oscillation and difficult to be precisely adjusted, because of the innate delay of the sensor. To solve this issue, this work proposes a deep learning method. We constructed a simplified system. Then we extracted the data sets from the sensor installed on the blender, using least square method to select the best data set as the principal of the future automatic running, whose procedures are scatter diagram generating, least squares curve generating and optimal data group selecting. Running according to the data set selected, the system can run autonomously, thus supposed to avoid the errors aroused by the oscillations and delays. This work paves a promising way to ensure the precise working of the load sensing system.

articleTitle: Demonstration of Rectangular Waveguides by Microfabrication Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 4th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: As the frequency goes up to the terahertz band, the dimensions of rectangular waveguide decrease, and the requirement of surface roughness increases, so advanced micromachining technology is employed to meet the requirements. This paper employed UV-LIGA (Ultraviolet-Lithography, electroplating and micro-molding) technology to microfabricate a terahertz rectangular waveguide with the standard internal cross-sectional dimension of a = 712 μm and b = 355μm, and the length of 25.4mm, operating at the frequency ranging from 280GHz to 400GHz. Microfabricated rectangular waveguide, with cros-ssectional dimensions of a=710±1μm and b=355±2μm has been achieved. The measurement result showed that the S<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">21</inf> of the prototype was between -2.52dB and -8.15dB from 320 to 400 GHz.

articleTitle: Optimized design of compound power supply system for explosion-proof electric rubber-tyred vehicles
publicationTitle: 2021 4th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: With the electrification of underground coal mines, electric explosion-proof rubber-tyred vehicles will gradually replace high-polluting explosion-proof diesel rubber-tyred vehicles, but explosion-proof electric rubber-tyred vehicles have problems such as short cruising range and poor power performance. Based on this, this paper proposes a pure electric explosion-proof rubber-tyred vehicle with a composite power supply. First, the vehicle power system and control system are calculated and analyzed, and then based on the vehicle power demand and system control strategy, the dynamic elite controlled NSGA-II algorithm is used to optimize the composite power parameters. After optimization, the vehicle economy and mileage have been significantly improved. Finally, an industrial test in the coal mine was carried out to verify the vehicle’s dynamic performance and actual cruising range.

articleTitle: Experimental analysis on vibration and noise of motor bearing of washing machine
publicationTitle: 2021 4th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: When a washing machine motor is adapted to the deep groove ball bearing 6202, it is selected between two bearings with different structural parameters. There is a large difference in vibration and noise response between the two bearings, and there is resonance sound at high speed. In this paper, the above problems are tested and analyzed. The analysis results show that the resonance sound is generated because the axial natural frequency of the washing machine motor is close to the natural characteristic frequency of the bearing inner ring. The surface roundness of the bearing inner ring will affect the overall vibration and noise performance of the motor. The greater the roundness runout, the greater the vibration and the greater the noise. When analyzing the vibration response, the frequency division vibration analysis method can accurately locate the problem, which is more effective than the direct frequency analysis method.

articleTitle: Size design and parameter optimization of embolization coil for cerebral aneurysm based on finite element compliance analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 4th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Spring coil embolization structure is difficult to manufacture in China, and the processing technology is not clear.so the imported coil is often chosen for embolism operation, which leads to the high cost of operation and is difficult to popularize. In this paper, the coil for cerebral aneurysm embolization is taken as the research object. By consulting literature, the material and shape of the coil are determined. According to the size parameters of the imported coil and arterial blood vessel parameters,designing the size of several groups of first-stage spring coil, and establishing a three-dimensional simulation model. By referring to the requirements and analysis methods of the compliance of interventing materials,carrying out a finite element analysis of the compliance between the imported spring coil and the designed size spring coil. By comparing the analysis results, designing the winding parameters of the first stage coil which are similar to the material, shape, size and compliance of the imported spring coil.

articleTitle: Design of High Loading Joint Bearing Testing Machine Based on ANSYS Finite Element Simulation
publicationTitle: 2021 4th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: This testing machine is mainly used to test the life and abrasion of joint bearing. The biggest characteristic of this machine is that it can be compact in structure, easy to assemble and disassemble a machine multi-purpose, different types of joint bearings can be selected to carry out life tests under the corresponding working conditions only by changing the corresponding supporting rotation axis. In addition, the selection method of loading system and driving motor is introduced. Finally, the dangerous parts are verified by ANSYS finite element simulation.

articleTitle: A monochromatic-light-interference system for measurement of diamond-indenter’s angle parameter
publicationTitle: 2021 4th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: The geometrical error of diamond indenter has much infection on the uncertainty of hardness measurement, especially for Rockwell hardness. Based on the system we realized an angle parameter measurement system for diamond indenter using monochromatic interference method and specially designed table. This paper analyses the system’s accuracy in detail. Standard angle block is specially designed for traceability of the system, of which the uncertainty can achieve $0.02^{\circ}(k=2)$. The application of the system to diamond indenter measurement is verified by the experiment using Rockwell diamond indenter.

articleTitle: The stress analysis of gear tooth root based on ANSYS
publicationTitle: 2021 4th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: In this paper, UG software is used to model the gears in three dimensions, and the interface technology of UG and ANSYS software is summarized to minimize the model conversion error during the import process. It is used in ANSYS software to calculate and analyze the root stress of the imported gear model. The traditional simplified formula of gear root stress is used to check the calculation results of ANSYS. The verification results show that the results of the two calculation methods are basically the same.

Author Keywords: simplified calculation of tooth root stress

articleTitle: Failure analysis and performance optimization of mechanical limit of a radar turntable
publicationTitle: 2021 4th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Mechanical limit is the last safety protection of the turntable, and its failures often bring unpredictable losses. This article analyzes the mechanical limit failure of a certain dimension radar turntable, conducts problem location and mechanism analysis, and gives solutions. A new type of limit structure combined with metal spring and rubber is proposed, and the energy storage capacity is greatly improved, the feasibility has been verified through the impact test. The research results and analysis methods of this case have guiding significance for solving similar faults.

articleTitle: A Local Resonance Metamaterial For Vibration Reduction
publicationTitle: 2021 4th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: The reduction of low-frequency vibration and noise has been a challenging task. A design of locally resonant metamaterial plate is proposed to overcome the difficulty of the low-frequency vibration reduction. The low-frequency vibration characteristics of the proposed structure are investigated numerically by the finite element method. The formation mechanism and influencing factors of the band gap in low-frequency vibration are analyzed, and the structure is optimized on this basis. It is found that the interaction between the local resonances and the traveling wave modes in the plate results in the formation of the locally resonant band gap, whose bandwidth depends on interaction strength and can be modulated by changing structural material parameters. The optimized structure can open lower and multiple band gaps and improve the attenuation performance of vibration wave. The results show that, the structure can open two complete range of vibration reduction with the width of 13Hz and 27 Hz in the frequency range below 250 Hz, and the starting frequency is as low as 180 Hz. The finite model with the number of 36 resonators has obvious effect to reduce vibration in the bandgap. The structure has potential application prospects.

articleTitle: Parametric Design of Gears Based on Secondary Development of SolidWorks Macros
publicationTitle: 2021 4th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: In order to solve the trouble that SolidWorks Toolbox can’t meet the requirements of accurate design of gear, the parametric design process of gear is analyzed by SolidWorks secondary development and numerical simulation method, and the gear models are successfully created by macro. The tooth profile curves of each gear are fitted by MATLAB. Besides, the tooth profile curve errors of parametric design and Toolbox are calculated. The results show that the parametric design method is faster and more accurate whose error is far less than that of Toolbox method, because the tooth profile curve of parametric design is involute, while that of toolbox is replaced by arc. This provides a parametric design method for the rapid and accurate modeling of gears.

articleTitle: Optimal Design of Vibration Fixture and Analysis of its Vibration Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2021 4th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Based on the theory of structural dynamics and Workbench software, the modal analysis and harmonic response analysis of a radar vibration fixture are carried out<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">[1]</sup>. The results show that the first order natural frequency of the fixture is low, and the difference of harmonic response between the sample points is large. By optimizing design and simulation analysis, the new fixture is obtained. The simulation results show that the first order natural frequency of the new fixture is increased by 49.1% and the difference between the sample points is reduced. The radar successfully passed the vibration test by using the new fixture<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">[2]</sup>.

articleTitle: Research on EPB Braking System for Mechanical Execution Elements
publicationTitle: 2021 4th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: With the development of automobile technology, EPB braking systems for buses are more and more widely used. While improving the performance of the automobile, it will also bring some matching problems, which will seriously affect the driving. In order to improve the reliability and safety of automobile driving, it is necessary to carry out matching research on mechanical components such as brakes and brake chambers under the system. The system has been applied in batches by domestic first-line brand manufacturers. The brand's system has a leading role in the industry, and the impact of unclear matching will lead to the further expansion of the system in the market. The content of this article is about the impact of EPB braking system on mechanical actuators.

articleTitle: The AGV Guidance of Giant Grinding-polishing Coalescence Robot by Machine Vision and Ackermann Steering System Design
publicationTitle: 2021 4th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: For the grinding and polishing process of the blade surface of a huge or super-jumbo wind driven generator with the working area at about 100$\times $5m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>, it usually adopts manual grinding operation, followed by manual polishing, with labor-intensity, or employs multi-small and medium-sized robot machine group with single grinding or polishing tool head,leading to two considerable problems as the core technical bottleneck are low accuracy even with unstable quality, and low productivity. Aiming at solving these problems, the current study proposes and designs a grinding- polishing coalesced giant robot to achieve high-precision in efficient grinding and polishing operation. One of the technical difficulties is “to operate in precision meanwhile to move in stability” for the robot. AGV guidance and Ackermann steering system provide an accurate, reliable, and stable position and gesture for the tool head. Based on machine vision and the parameters of the horizontal line of the blade as the basic navigation information, specified reference points are accurately located and possible static objects are literally spotted for auxiliary reference points between the blade and the robot, making the vehicle move from the start, through the intermediate operation, to job completion according to the rational threshold value in the design. In consideration of the high efficiency of the giant robot, the self-guided vehicle is designed with double beams, four bridges and eight wheels as the basic characteristics. Ackermann trapezoidal steering is introduced in the vehicle smartly and in compact. Eight wheels are specially designed with special selection of materials in four groupe. Two groups of wheels are for guiding-positioning-supporting wheels are set at both ends of the vehicle while the middle two groups of wheels are for positioning-supporting. All these tyres are meridian type with reinforced steel wires. On the basis of ensuring strong rigidity, the robot is able to grind and polish continuously and efficiently in motion.

Author Keywords: giant grinding and polishing combined robot

articleTitle: Key Technologies of Energy Saving and Emission Reduction for Light Electric RTG
publicationTitle: 2021 4th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: The main handling equipment of container yard is general rubber tired gantry crane. However, it is not suitable for small and middle container yard because of high cost, maintain complex, high energy consumption. Based on general RTG, four-drum combined control technology with container hoisting and trolley moving is used in light electric RTG. Hoisting and trolley moving mechanism drive devices are combined to one device which is arranged in the bottom beam of crane. In the premise of ensuring the overall performance, the height of center of gravity is greatly reduced, stability of crane is improved. Accordingly, the parameters of crane are optimized, the weight of the structure is reduced. Moreover, frequency control and energy recovery system is developed for the light electric RTG. So, light electric RTG has the characteristics of light weight, low investment, low energy consumption, zero emissions, cost-effective, energy saving and environmental protection. It is suitable for small and middle container terminal.

articleTitle: Study on Microstructure and Properties of TiC Reinforced Stellite F Alloy Laser Cladding Layer
publicationTitle: 2021 4th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: TiC Reinforced Stellite F alloy cladding layer was prepared on the surface of 304 stainless steel by laser cladding technology to improve the wear resistance and hardness of stainlesssteel surface. The cladding layer was analyzed by X-ray diffraction, metallographic examination, hardness examination, wear test and scanning electron microscope. The results show that the Stellite $\mathbf{F}$ laser cladding layer is mainly composed of $\gamma \mathrm{Co},\mathrm{Cr}_{2}\mathrm{Ni}_{3}$ and $\mathrm{Ni}_{1}7\mathrm{~W}_{3}$ phases. After TiC is added, the cladding layer were formed with $\mathrm{Cr}_{3}\mathrm{C}_{2},\mathrm{Co}_{3}\mathrm{Ti}$ and TiC phases. The microstructure of Stellite F laser cladding layer is composed of plane crystal, dendriTiC crystal and equiaxed crystal. After TiC is added, massive phases with different sizes and shapes appeared in the cladding layer, which were mainly composed of TiC and newly formed intermetallic compounds of titanium. When the addition amount of TiC is less than 10%, the hardness of laser cladding layer does not increase but decreases, and the wear resistance at room temperature becomes worse. When the addition amount of TiC reaches 20%, the hardness and room temperature wear resistance of the cladding layer are significantly improved, the hardness reaches 876HV, and the room temperature wear resistance is more than 15 times that of 304 stainlesssteel.

articleTitle: Research on high precision location algorithm for trajectory tracking of service robot
publicationTitle: 2021 4th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the trajectory tracking of service robot deviates from the set trajectory due to the low positioning accuracy of single sensor, a combined information positioning method is proposed. The odometer and lidar are selected as the positioning sensor of the indoor service robot to study the high-precision positioning and tracking algorithm based on trajectory tracking. At the same time, in view of the reasonable selection of service robot landmark and the uncertainty of observed landmark data, the links of observation landmark selection and prediction observation matching are added to the positioning algorithm. The simulation results show that the combined information positioning method overcomes the defect of low positioning accuracy of a single sensor and has high positioning accuracy.

articleTitle: Second-order Counterexample Trajectory Characteristics of the Discrete-time Kalman Conjecture
publicationTitle: 2021 4th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: The method of finding the second-order counterexample of the discrete-time Kalman Conjecture and corresponding counterexamples’ trajectory characteristics has been listed in this article with a specific saturation nonlinearity. A conclusion can be made from both numerical and analytical methods, the robust stability of the specified discrete time lurye system can be found with respect of certain region of nonlinearity.

articleTitle: Foot Trajectory Planning and Prototype Experiment of Double Closed-Chain Walking Leg
publicationTitle: 2021 4th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: A 2-DOF double closed-chain walking leg was proposed, which the first closed-chain adopted a crank rocker mechanism to realize the step and swing action of walking leg; the second closed-chain adopted a crank slider mechanism to adjust the step height of walking leg. Given the different rotational speed ratio and phase difference of the crank of the two mechanisms, different foot-end trajectories could be obtained. Considering the advantages and disadvantages of common foot-end trajectories, the waist type foot-end trajectory was selected as the research object. Firstly, the mathematical model of foot-end trajectory of walking leg was established. Then, taking the minimum distance between waist foot-end trajectory and compound cycloid foot-end trajectory as the optimization objective, the optimization model of walking leg bar size was established. The optimized walking leg bar size was obtained by using genetic algorithm. Finally, the walking leg simulation and prototype experiment were carried out, and the simulation and experiment results verified the feasibility of leg structure and foot-end trajectory planning.

articleTitle: Design of a New Cylindrical Manipulator Based on TRIZ Conflict Theory
publicationTitle: 2021 4th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Cylindrical manipulator is a necessary tool for modern industry in China, and has broad prospects for development in various fields of national economy. The main purpose of this paper is to design a cylindrical manipulator, the cylindrical manipulator along the predetermined trajectory requirements to complete the grasp of the workpiece, with mobile positioning function. This design is based on the theory of TRIZ conflict matrix analysis and solve the problem of the technical conflict, first to confirm the structure of the manipulator, secondly according to the structure of the manipulator styles determine its driving mode, finally according to the request of manipulator scheduled work and drive way to determine its control mode, the final design a new type of high efficiency and energy saving of the cylindrical manipulator.

articleTitle: Multi-scale residual reconstruction algorithm based on compressed sensing image
publicationTitle: 2021 4th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Existing compressed sensing image reconstruction algorithms based on deep learning have the problems of poor reconstructed image quality and blurred local areas. A multi-scale residual reconstruction network based on compressed sensing images is proposed. The proposed network consists of sampling sub-network and reconstruction sub-network.. First, the sampling sub-network performs compressed sensing sampling on the entire image through global convolution, and then obtains a preliminary reconstructed image through deconvolution; the reconstruction sub-network has multi-scale residual blocks with different sizes of convolution kernels, and each residual block has Different branches extract multiple image features. The experimental results show that the reconstructed image of the proposed network has better visual effects and clearer details. At the same time, the local information and texture structure of the image are enhanced, and the objective index of PSNR is significantly improved.

articleTitle: Sleep staging of mouse based on Neurochat implantable intelligent control system
publicationTitle: 2021 4th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: The foundation of many visions of future science and technology needs to establish the connection between animal brain and external equipment through brain computer interface to realize the information exchange between brain and the outside world. This project improved the production of the brain-computer interface acquisition component-Neurochat series, which realized the signal acquisition from brain waves to local field potentials and neuron spikes. Through the relevant signals collected by Neurochat Series, we successfully realized the staging of the sleep state of mice, and provided effective support for the next step of EEG information extraction and intelligent control.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Collaboration of Two-Layer Self-Organizing Network
publicationTitle: 2021 4th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: In the context of intelligent manufacturing, the intelligent development of mechanical engineering is an important scientific and technological support to promote human progress. Complex networks have the characteristics of self-organization. When uncertain changes occur, they can adjust their organizational structure in time to achieve the desired goals. We consider a two-layer coupled social network with offline network information transmission and online network opinion collaboration. The direction of the random walker in the lower layer depends on the degree of nodes in the upper layer network; at the same time, the frequency of the upper layer oscillator is affected by the distribution of the lower layer random walker. Through simulation, we have observed the emergence of explosive synchronization, a slight change in the distribution of random walkers causes large-scale sudden synchronization. In addition, we have studied the influence of different parameters on synchronization. The larger the scope of self-organization, the more uncertainty. By continuously improving its self-organization, we can try to create a stable and intelligent self-organizing network. It provides a solid theoretical foundation and expansion direction for the research on network proliferation, disease transmission and intelligent control of the network.

articleTitle: Surface defect detection of carbon fiber prepreg based on image processing
publicationTitle: 2021 4th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: With the application of automatic laying technology in the aerospace field more and more widely, how to ensure the laying quality of components in the laying process has become one of the focus issues. So far, the defect detection of carbon fiber pre rubber materials are mainly artificial vision, which has low detection efficiency, high false detection rate and missed detection rate, and high labor intensity, which is unfavorable to workers. Therefore, the research of automatic defect detection based on machine vision is of great significance. In this paper, the actual collected carbon fiber prepreg image was taken as the research object, and a detection method of carbon fiber prepreg defect based on Gabor filter based on scale transformation was proposed. The image texture compression algorithm proposed in this paper was used to determine the final defect area by setting the threshold value. By adjusting the parameter value to 1, the best image segmentation result is obtained.

articleTitle: Temperature field simulation and structure optimization of asphalt heating furnace
publicationTitle: 2021 4th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of low heating efficiency of asphalt heating furnace, the temperature field simulation model of asphalt heating furnace is established. By simulating the process of gas flow, the temperature field, temperature streamline and the temperature of eight outlets in the asphalt heating furnace are obtained. In order to improve the heating effect of asphalt heating furnace, the structure of the model is optimized. The effects of the gas inlet position of the asphalt heating furnace and the chamfer side length of the deflector in the lower furnace cavity on the gas outlet temperature are analyzed. The results indicate that the model with gas inlet on one side can improve the heating effect, and the addition of deflector in the lower furnace cavity can further improve the heating effect of high-temperature gas on Asphalt in the stirred tank.

articleTitle: The utility model relates to an integral clutch booster with a shift control valve
publicationTitle: 2021 4th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: In view of the current commercial vehicles in the clutch system failure of the high problem, and users pay more and more attention to vehicle maintenance, the original traditional structure gradually can not meet the needs of customers, the development of a shift control valve with the integral clutch booster.A product with the function of reflecting the actual working schedule and reminding customers of the maintenance of the clutch system.In structure, more compact than the original traditional structure, longer service life, more perfect function.

articleTitle: Design and research of non-contact Optical density measuring device
publicationTitle: 2021 4th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Accurate measurement of optical density plays an important role in the fields of biology, medicine, material, image analysis, printing, painting and photography. It is an important link to measure and guarantee the printing quality. Especially when the color difference is less than 1.0, it is difficult for the human eye to distinguish the difference between the two, only the instrument can measure their color difference and optical density value to distinguish. Aiming at the problem that the reflective gray-scale test card used in the photographic industry for evaluating image quality cannot be used for traditional contact measurement, the optical density measurement theory and the characteristics of non-contact measurement are studied, a simple and feasible test scheme is proposed, and a parallel optical tube and a 45/0 automatic control corner system are designed. A high precision, non-contact optical density measurement system is established, used for measuring the optical density of materials with small size, bending and easy to leave scratches. Based on the measurement experiments and experimental data analysis of the TE-108 reflective gray scale test card produced by German company Image Engineering, it shows that the measuring device has obvious advantages in measuring accuracy, reliability, measuring efficiency and measuring cost.

articleTitle: Manufacturing Execution System Driven by Industrial Big Data
publicationTitle: 2021 4th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: With the rapid development of the Internet, traditional manufacturing execution systems can no longer meet the needs of the intelligent manufacturing industry. In today’s manufacturing execution system, most of the process flow is relatively rough for man-hour management, makes the product unable to obtain accurate product production hours during production, has a great impact on production scheduling, As a result, the production efficiency of the enterprise is affected, and a certain amount of production resources is wasted. This article will use big data technology to solve the above problems. Therefore, promoting the integration of big data technology and manufacturing execution system is an important technical means for the transformation and upgrading of the intelligent manufacturing industry in the future.

articleTitle: A Vibration Reduction of a Lightweight Metamaterial Beam
publicationTitle: 2021 4th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Metamaterials have special properties that natural materials do not have, such as negative refractive index, negative stiffness, etc. The study on vibration reduction of metamaterial beams is a hot spot<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">[2]</sup>. This paper proposes a local resonance type lightweight metamaterial beam that can not only realize the vibration reduction in the low frequency range, but also can improve the structure with light weight. In this paper, the solid mechanics module of the COMSOL Multiphysics software is used to calculate the modes and frequency response curves of the semi-paved metamaterial beam. It can be concluded that this structure can achieve the dual requirements of lightweight and vibration reduction.

articleTitle: A scheme and kinematics analysis of an assembly vehicle for terminal optical component of a laser fusion device
publicationTitle: 2021 4th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Laser fusion devices are ascending. However, the installation of the terminal optical component (TOC) is the key link and difficult technical problem. In this paper, in order to solve the problem, a new scheme of a 6-DOF terminal optical component assembly vehicle is proposed. In this paper, the structural composition and working principle are given, and its motion space and working characteristics are analyzed. Based on kinematic model of the vehicle, the equation is derived with homogeneous coordinates. And the TOC pose expression is given. And then the envelope of the trajectory of the TOC carried by the assembly vehicle is drawn. Taking the TOC installation of a laser fusion device as an example, the key process of TOC installation is simulated, which proves the accessibility and high efficiency of the assembly vehicle. Compared with traditional installation equipment, this device has significant advantages in terms of accessibility, avoidance of environmental obstacles in the assembly ground, and operation accuracy. The scheme and kinematics equations of this assembly vehicle can provide a theoretical basis for the development of similar equipment.

articleTitle: Study on the Coupling Impact Dynamics of a Launcher under Sea State 6
publicationTitle: 2021 4th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: The paper extends the study of a launcher for projectiles, whose previous research are mainly about coupling impact dynamics on land. To study the launcher’s characteristics of coupling impact dynamic under sea state 6, the authors take research in its motion characteristics on a ship under the sea state. Based on a three-dimensional model of the launcher on the finite element analysis software ANSYS and the dynamic design analysis method DDAM, the analysis and calculation of the impact resistance of the launcher is carried out to assess its capability of impact resistance, the conclusions of which are of some significance to the structural strength design of the launcher under complex sea conditions.

articleTitle: Effect of Alloying Treatment on Properties and Cost of High Manganese Steel
publicationTitle: 2021 4th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: For more than 100 years, to improve wear resistance to make it can be used in a variety of fields, scholars have studied new wear-resistant steel, and constantly through changing the smelting process, casting process and heat treatment process prolong the life of wear-resisting steel. In this study, the original high manganese steel can be alloying treated with some elements, such as vanadium, titanium and rare earth. By means of metallographic microscope, scanning electron microscope, hardness test and wear test, the effects of V, Ti and rare earth alloying treatment on the microstructure and properties of high manganese steel were investigated. The results showed that V-Ti-RE alloying could obviously refine the grain, reduce the amount of inclusions, improve the size, shapes and distribution of the inclusions, and better the hardness and wear resistance of the inclusions. In a certain period of time, the utilization rate of high manganese steel will be increased and the cost will be decreased. The experimental results can provide guidance for the production of more wear-resistant materials.

articleTitle: Effect of Mo Alloying on Properties of High Manganese Steel Castings and Cost Analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 4th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Under the condition of high stress and high impact wear, the new anti-wear material with high toughness has high application value. In this paper, in order to improve the wear resistance of high manganese steel to better meet the service conditions, and to reduce the cost of materials. The effect of molybdenum alloying on the structure and mechanical properties of high manganese steel was studied. Combined with numerical simulation, the filling, solidification temperature change and shrinkage cavity defects of the casting were analyzed. The simulation results are in good agreement with the actual production castings, and the casting quality is improved. The test results show that the mechanical properties of alloyed high manganese steel castings are better than those of high manganese steel castings. The tensile strength, hardness and impact toughness of high manganese steel castings are increased by 13.06%, 49.41% and 44.7% respectively. Mo element can significantly better the mechanical property, the microstructure, the shape of the steel. According to the experimental results and material cost analysis, the cost variation trend of high manganese steel can be predicted while improving its performance.

articleTitle: Identification of key quality characteristics of triple-extrusion process of power cable based on extreme gradient boosting algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 4th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: With the development of industrial Internet, power companies collect a large number of production and process data of cable enterprises to control the quality of cable. But there is lack of basis for judging cable quality through production data, and the core index identification and evaluation system of cable production process needs to be established at present. Aiming at the problem of cable quality control, this paper takes the Triple-Extrusion process data of a 500 kV cable collected on the EIP platform as the research object, analyzes the distribution and correlation of the production data of the process, extracts and sorts the key process parameters of the process by using XGBoost algorithm, verifies the sorting of parameters through cross validation, and compares them with the actual production process. The results show that XGBoost algorithm can effectively identify the key process parameters of cable production process, evaluate the cable production quality, and provide reference for power cable process improvement and quality control.

articleTitle: Computer aided synthesis method for movable soil-blocking plate of micro-cultivator
publicationTitle: 2021 4th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: In order to solve the problem that it is difficult to clean the weeds wrapped by micro-cultivator, the design scheme of movable soil-blocking plate is proposed, and the computer-aided synthesis method of its guiding device is studied. Firstly, the working principle of the movable soil-blocking plate of the micro-cultivator is introduced, and the guidance position information of the soil-blocking plate is given; Secondly, the solution methods of circle curve and center curve are introduced based on Burmester theory. On this basis, a Type Map method based on automatic defect discrimination technology is proposed, and the corresponding design software is developed; Finally, the kinematics and dynamics characteristics of the soil-blocking plate guide mechanism including the driving device are analyzed. The results show that the movable soil-blocking plate scheme designed in this study is feasible, and the computer-aided position synthesis method proposed for this design process also has high design efficiency, which can effectively avoid the blindness of selecting the center point in the synthesis calculation.

articleTitle: Research on Man-Robot Serial Cooperative Two-sided Assembly Line Balancing Based on NSGA-II
publicationTitle: 2021 4th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Under the background of Industrial 4.0, the manrobot cooperation assembly mode is more and more widely used in the manufacturing industry. This paper takes the man-robot serial collaborative two-sided assembly line as the research goal and establishes the type-II line balance optimization model firstly, which includes three sub-problems: the selection of assembly modes, the allocation and sequencing of operations and the control of cost. Then, this paper improves the algorithm on the basic of the traditional NSGA-II to solve the model, two vectors are used for coding to solve the selection of assembly modes and the allocation and sequencing of operations, and a reasonable neighborhood structure is designed to prevent the algorithm from falling into local optimization. Finally, the effectiveness of the model and algorithm is verified by a specific example.

articleTitle: Research on the Self- adaption All-Terrain Transportation Platform for Sprinkler Irrigation Operation
publicationTitle: 2021 4th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: As an efficient and water-saving irrigation technology, sprinkler irrigation is widely used in northern China. To cope with the complicated and changeable environments of sprinkling irrigation and improve the environmental adaptability of the sprinkler irrigation transportation platform, an $8\times 8$ multi-wheel all-terrain sprinkler irrigation transportation platform was put forward. The platform adopts the arrangement of two sets of double cross arm independent suspensions at the front and rear and two sets of longitudinal swing arm independent suspensions in the middle. The combination of the suspension and the autonomous oil-gas spring makes the wheel jump up and down with a range of 220mm, which can realize the position adjustment of the transportation platform and improve the platform’s environmental adaptability to meet the needs of operations in different environments such as gentle slope terraces, undulating farmland, sloping roads, roadblocks, and trenches. According to the geometric relations, the suspension structure diagram of the transportation platform was established and the kinematic analysis calculation was conducted to realize the parameterization of the transportation platform. The operating conditions of the transportation platform were parameterized, the typical environments were extracted to establish simulated terrains, and software was applied to build a dynamic analysis model to simulate and verify the extreme obstacle crossing conditions of the transportation platform in typical environments, including crossing the limit vertical wall, resisting limit vertical slope of overturning, resisting limit horizontal slope of overturning, and limit width of crossing trench. Through theoretical analysis and simulation verification, it is concluded that the combination of structural layout and motion strategy can effectively improve the adaptability of the transportation platform.

articleTitle: Dynamics Modeling and Servomotor Parameter Estimation of a 3-Spherical-Prismatic-Revolute Parallel Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2021 4th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Parallel mechanisms have been widely used due to their high rigidity and good dynamic performance. Dynamics modeling and servomotor parameter estimation are the main contents in the design of parallel mechanisms. A method for the rigid body dynamics model of 3-SPR parallel mechanism is proposed using the reaction wrenches and velocity twists applied upon the joints. The velocity and acceleration analysis of joints and limbs in the 3-SPR parallel manipulator are discussed in detail by using screw theory and Lie bracket. Then the reaction wrenches and velocity twists applied upon the joints are established, followed by the actuated force of three actuators are obtained based on the virtual work principle. The method to estimate servomotor parameters is proposed by evaluating the peak torques and the average moments of inertia of the actuators, providing a theoretical foundation for the determination of servomotor specifications.

articleTitle: Joint optimization of flow-shop scheduling and maintenance planning with processing speed selection by an improved genetic algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 4th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: With the continuous development of intelligent manufacturing, the production scheduling and preventive maintenance gain widespread application in industry. In this context, this paper investigates an integrated problem of flow-shop scheduling and maintenance planning with processing speed selection. First, the effects of variable operating conditions (OCs) are incorporated into the maintenance model due to the selectable processing speeds. Next, a mathematical model with variable processing speeds is established with minimizing the total cost including the tardiness and maintenance cost. To address the presented model, an improved genetic algorithm (IGA) with a speed-based variable neighborhood search (VNS) is proposed. Then, a series of comparative cases are performed. Finally, the results reveal that the proposed model is superior to the model with constant speeds in maintaining machines at a high reliability. Meanwhile, the effectiveness and feasibility of the proposed algorithm are demonstrated.

articleTitle: Control of microstructure and properties for tantalum-tungsten alloy component manufacturing in cold forging and subsequent annealing process
publicationTitle: 2021 4th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: In mechanical engineering and intelligent manufacturing research area, excellent surface quality and dimensional accuracy at the macro level for products manufactured by means of information and intelligent technology are desired, at the same time, their controls of microstructure and properties at the microscopic scale are also of great concern. Tantalum-tungsten (Ta-W) alloy components are widely used in high temperatures, ballistics, and aerospace fields due to their advantages of high density, high plasticity, and good corrosion resistance. Therefore, in this paper, by studying the influence of processing parameters of heat treatment on microstructure and properties in cold forging deformation, tantalum-tungsten alloy components with homogeneous and fine-grained microstructure as well as excellent mechanical properties can be successfully achieved. Results show that the average grain size of Ta-W alloy components reaches the minimum when annealed at 1300 °C for 60 min, which is less than 25 μm. The recrystallization process of Ta-W alloy components with a reduction of 74% has completed at the annealing temperature of 1300 °C, and apparently grain growth occurs when the annealing temperature reaches 1400 °C. With the increase of annealing temperature paremeters, the microhardness of Ta-W alloy components decreases at first then slightly increases. The increase of microhardness at 1400 °C is likely due to the tendency of refractory metals to oxidize at high temperatures. After annealing treatment, the deformation of Ta-W alloy components shows obvious elastic-plastic deformation behavior, and its elongation reaches a maximum value of 46%.

articleTitle: Research on three-stage point cloud registration mode optimized by simulated annealing algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 4th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: In order to solve the defects of traditional point cloud registration iterative nearest point (ICP) algorithm in the case of random initial rotation and translation matrix, it is easy to fall into local optimal, time-consuming iteration, and lacks self-adjustment ability, and meet the real-time requirements of using lidar to collect vehicle contour information. A three-stage point cloud registration mode optimized by annealing algorithm is proposed. Through the three-stage point cloud registration mode, the first stage is point-to-point registration, and the simulated annealing algorithm is used to select the matching pairs of feature points. The second stage registration is the registration of features. The first stage registration is used as input to construct feature point clouds for registration. The third part is point cloud to point cloud registration, and the ICP algorithm of KD-tree search optimization is used for the overall registration. Experimental results show that. This algorithm can obtain better vehicle contour point cloud, and by comparing classical ICP, principal component analysis (PCA)-ICP, FPFH-ICP and other algorithms, the algorithm proposed in this paper takes less time to register different environments and objects. The complete car contour can provide the basis for the control of the subsequent robot and has reference significance for the study of laser point cloud processing.

articleTitle: Design and Position & Gesture Matrix Expression of 3-DOF Wrist of Two-color Sole Molding Robot
publicationTitle: 2021 4th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: In the multi-color sole molding process, multiple robots instead of manual operation are used. The robot end-effector must complete the serial action of mold closing, residual material cleaning, mold opening, inspecting and up-picking of the work as the main functions and techniques. In this paper, based on the new technological process of the sole injection, robot logical action sequence, and functional requirements and mechanism theory, a wrist compact in structure and independent in motion with three degrees of freedom was designed. According to the new molding process, the three end-effectors, namely, the opening and closing actuator, the flapping residual material cleaning actuator, and the inspection and picking actuator, were connected with the wrist after logic induction and integration of action functions. By setting the local coordinate system and the global coordinate system, the unified matrix expression describing the position of the base, the arm and the wrist reference points and the gestures of three end-effectors was developed, so that the robot's action function is fully matched with the multi-color sole molding process requirements of the robot replacing the operator. Such expression provides effective methods and means for further research, test and optimization of wrist and robot systems.

articleTitle: Study of Quenching Device Design Method and Flow Regulation Theory Based on “Solid Contact-Fluid Heat Transfer” Mode
publicationTitle: 2021 4th World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: This paper uses graph theory and Kirchhoff’s law of pipe network to establish a hydraulic calculation model of pipe network. It uses the principle of flow measurement and the rule of loop pressure balancing to address the problems of the uneven surface cooling speed of processed thin plate parts due to unreasonable flow distribution of cooling pipes in the internal pipe network system of quenching device based on “solid contact-fluid heat transfer” mode, which leads to deformation and cracking of parts. The feasibility of applying the established pipe network hydraulic calculation model to the pipe network system of the “solid contact-fluid heat transfer” quenching device for flow control is validated through flow control and data detection and analysis of the actual running pipe network system. Simultaneously, the traditional quenching method is easy to produce large deformation, tedious leveling process, low product qualification rate, and serious environmental severe when processing thin plate parts. The quenching device designed in this paper is to achieve the non-contact quenching between the processed parts and the quenching medium through the heat transfer of the fluid in the cooling pipe. The structure design of the internal cooling channel will directly affect the cooling effect of the sheet metal during the cold quenching, thus determining the microstructure and final performance of the product. Therefore, based on the basic principles of heat transfer and the theory of flow regulation, combined with the traditional design scheme, this paper proposed a practical quenching device design method, established the theoretical model of the cooling waterway structure parameters in the quenching device, and obtained the corresponding relationship between each structural parameter and the number of cooling channels through solving. It provides a reliable research method for the follow-up research on the relationship between cold quenching process parameters, cooling channel structure parameters, and cooling effect of thin plate parts.
